TFVC Political Director Michelle Evans was appointed to the Platform Committee and sat on the Health and Human Services subcommittee. She worked tirelessly to ensure the Republican party was serious about advancing medical liberty in Texas. Meanwhile, I had the chance to [testify before the Legislative Priorities Committee](https://click.mlsend.com/link/c/YT0yNDk3NTMxODQ2NjQ0OTk2ODMwJmM9azB3NCZlPTAmYj0xMzI5MDMyMTM0JmQ9bjF3OHg2ZA==.IpGw2o0zTWaH6tcgdAaI9p3TtOV5Rf_gmZI9gG9AF-4) to advocate for stronger and more direct verbiage that would address the urgent issues Texans are still currently experiencing. name: Hillsdale College via Trump News HQ
subject: The greatest armed conflict in human history
body:
Only a fraction of the 16 million Americans who fought bravely in World War II remain with us.

This sponsored message from Trump Train News is on behalf of Hillsdale College
[](https://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2z5vi24ppvoefsq1o928s1e2mapccdd95fsstb4no_rp22sh2s8i6ep37c3j69o32cth2bs) Dear Fellow American,
Only a fraction of the 16 million Americans who fought bravely in World War II remain with us. This fact means that we’re losing more and more living memory of the greatest armed conflict in human history, which makes the study of World War II even more important.
To this end, Hillsdale College has produced an online course called **“The Second World Wars.”**
**Taught by historian Victor Davis Hanson** , this course explores how the conflict’s diverse theaters, belligerents, and ways of fighting came eventually to define a single war. And it examines the key investments, strategies, and leaders that led the Allied powers to victory over the Axis. [](https://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2zoagebbonsogdiokieesn10l5uvbcqj2nugbeldo_rp22sh2s8i6ep37c3j69o32cth2bs) If you’d like to secure a DVD set before they’re all gone, you can get one shipped directly to your home for any gift of $100 or more to Hillsdale College.
Here’s a secure link to reserve your copy of **“The Second World Wars”** on DVD:
**[https://secured.hillsdale.edu/hillsdale/support-the-second-world-wars](https://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2z0bjcqqs7aafha9878tbbpnrpc1cvo5ha0vfjlpo_rp22sh2s8i6ep37c3j69o32cth2bs)**
Thank you for preserving liberty for future generations of Americans through education with Hillsdale College!
Best regards,
Jeremiah Regan, Ph.D. Executive Director of Online Learning Hillsdale College

| | Friend,They lied about the origin of Covid... they lied about the data... and they lied about the science. They called you a conspiracy theorist, accused you of spreading misinformation and even banned you from social media.They said it was OK for you to shop at big box stores and participate in race riots – while they closed down your church, small businesses and schools. And then they demanded that you take an experimental vaccine if you wanted to travel, go out in public, or even keep your job. Millions of Americans reluctantly complied even though they felt like this was a violation of their bodily autonomy – and in some case, their religious beliefs.**Tens of thousands of hardworking Americans refused to give in and were fired when they refused to get the Covid shot.** Doctors, nurses, teachers, members of the military, and many more.And now that we know more of the truth about Covid, the vaccine, and the shady collusion between government organizations, Big Tech and Big Pharma......they’d love nothing more than to sweep this all under the rug and pretend it never happened. **That’s why I’ve instructed our attorneys at the Center for American Liberty to continue legal action to hold them accountable.** For starters, we filed a lawsuit against the North Carolina Symphony on behalf of three musicians fired for refusing to get the COVID vaccine. _Each of them had been employed by the_ _ __Symphony_ _ __for over 10 years._[**And if we can win this critical legal battle, we can put employers across the country on notice that they should reinstate victims of their COVID vaccine firings.**](http://e.1600daily.com/rd/9z2zn60bp1ov93523tp0r881r5igq74tp49cj8pjq6g_rp22sh2s8i6ep37c3gm0o70s5h2bs) When the Symphony first introduced its vaccine mandate, it offered both religious and medical exemptions.Dovid, Chris, and Rachel filed for religious exemptions, and expressed a willingness to take other measures—like regular COVID testing—to ensure safety.But the Symphony rejected ALL of them and put them on a year of UNPAID LEAVE.These three musicians were Buddhist, Christian and Jewish.**To you and me, the freedom to practice your religion is a sacred right.****So is your right to bodily autonomy.** But in the eyes of the cultural Marxists who control so many institutions in America today, your body doesn’t belong to you – it belongs to them.They’ll decide where you go... They’ll decide what you need... They’ll decide what you can have... They’ll decide what vaccines you must take...In other words: _Your individual liberties_ will cease to exist. The good news is that while cultural Marxism is booming on college campuses and inside government bureaucracies......the vast majority of Americans are against it. This is a fight we can win – and we must win. [**You can join me today by making a generous, tax-deductible donation to the Center for American Liberty to fund this lawsuit for medical and religious freedom, and set a precedent nationwide that puts these radicals on notice.**](http://e.1600daily.com/rd/9z2zsmdq3cekqc90ts7trocatlh0elakcitbi8ihl40_rp22sh2s8i6ep37c3gm0o70s5h2bs) Even after the North Carolina Symphony lifted its vaccine mandate, it refused to give these musicians their jobs back.Because it was never about “science” or “health” – it was always about control.And it’s time to tell the cultural Marxists who want to control every aspect of your life that we aren’t backing down.I hope I can count on your support.
---

name: Hillsdale College via 1600 Daily
subject: C.S. Lewis's Profound Insights
body:
His signature ability to communicate the truth about Christianity has inspired countless skeptics

This sponsored message from 1600 Daily is on behalf of Hillsdale College | | | [](http://e.1600daily.com/rd/9z2zgicmv4qbrsanj1j29fct3sutet8mv3i6qfvl2ug_rp22sh2s8i6ep37c3gm2ob7c3h2bs)
---
| | Dear Friend, C.S. Lewis was a master at addressing life's most important questions through vivid language that is delightful and captivating to read.

His signature ability to communicate the truth about Christianity has inspired countless skeptics to become believers and even more believers to renew and deepen their faith--making him the greatest Christian apologist of the twentieth century.

That's why we produced "[**C.S. Lewis on Christianity,**](http://e.1600daily.com/rd/9z2zime733jj7a3uaodnsamehr94hgguduh910gpvr0_rp22sh2s8i6ep37c3gm2ob7c3h2bs)" which you can now own on DVD.
---
| [](http://e.1600daily.com/rd/9z2zv0do8u7brnm13t986f0udba8hfvfah34g2jd2ro_rp22sh2s8i6ep37c3gm2ob7c3h2bs)
---
| | In this course you will learn Lewis's profound insights on the central topics of Christianity, including:
* good and evil,
* conversion and faith,
* prayer and the Bible,
* suffering and death,
* heaven and hell, and much more.

Dr. Ward is a Distinguished Visiting Professor at Hillsdale College and a member of the Faculty of Theology and Religion at the University of Oxford. He is the author of _Planet Narnia: The Seven Heavens in the Imagination of C.S. Lewis_ and _After Humanity: A Guide to C.S. Lewis 's The Abolition of Man_, and the co-editor of _The Cambridge Companion to C.S. Lewis_. He even spent three years living in Lewis's Oxford home as the resident Warden of The Kilns!

This course is especially moving because it examines C.S. Lewis's beautiful writings about faith and traces Lewis's own journey from skeptic to believer. The combination provides an opportunity for us to grow in our knowledge and understanding of Christianity.

That's why I hope you'll join us in examining the eternal questions of Christianity with C.S. Lewis with [this beautiful DVD box set](http://e.1600daily.com/rd/9z2zlrlbs6gvj8khmdet49ro4ff2ahdoug9ivv3pvn8_rp22sh2s8i6ep37c3gm2ob7c3h2bs).

Best regards,

Kyle Murnen, '09
Director of Online Learning
Hillsdale College

subject: C.S. Lewis's Profound Insights
body:
His signature ability to communicate the truth about Christianity has inspired countless skeptics

This sponsored message from American Action News is on behalf of Hillsdale College | | | [](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2z151dh7avhc8k2j2rml0o1lou2n1pg5fgmogmkoo_rp22sh2s8i6ep37c3gm6oj4cth2bs)
---
| | Dear Friend, C.S. Lewis was a master at addressing life's most important questions through vivid language that is delightful and captivating to read.

His signature ability to communicate the truth about Christianity has inspired countless skeptics to become believers and even more believers to renew and deepen their faith--making him the greatest Christian apologist of the twentieth century.

That's why we produced "[**C.S. Lewis on Christianity,**](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2z4dhcb6uljl5ecc1h5bi0m6ceun6vtiq7hh4n1t0_rp22sh2s8i6ep37c3gm6oj4cth2bs)" which you can now own on DVD.
---
| [](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zur66atkjpc92ogd4dbg55oq2iov30tuo2mgmv9o_rp22sh2s8i6ep37c3gm6oj4cth2bs)
---
| | In this course you will learn Lewis's profound insights on the central topics of Christianity, including:
* good and evil,
* conversion and faith,
* prayer and the Bible,
* suffering and death,
* heaven and hell, and much more.

Dr. Ward is a Distinguished Visiting Professor at Hillsdale College and a member of the Faculty of Theology and Religion at the University of Oxford. He is the author of _Planet Narnia: The Seven Heavens in the Imagination of C.S. Lewis_ and _After Humanity: A Guide to C.S. Lewis 's The Abolition of Man_, and the co-editor of _The Cambridge Companion to C.S. Lewis_. He even spent three years living in Lewis's Oxford home as the resident Warden of The Kilns!

This course is especially moving because it examines C.S. Lewis's beautiful writings about faith and traces Lewis's own journey from skeptic to believer. The combination provides an opportunity for us to grow in our knowledge and understanding of Christianity.

That's why I hope you'll join us in examining the eternal questions of Christianity with C.S. Lewis with [this beautiful DVD box set](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zjgj125lubh0chopub7e3bpeiq1b0u4d52avst10_rp22sh2s8i6ep37c3gm6oj4cth2bs).

Best regards,

Kyle Murnen, '09
Director of Online Learning
Hillsdale College

| | | This week, Governor Glenn Youngkin commemorated and recognized the 80th anniversary of D-Day at the National D-Day Memorial in Bedford where the valor, fidelity, and sacrifice of our Allied Forces are honored every day. Governor Youngkin spoke of the bravery of the men who stormed the beaches that day and honored the legacy of the legendary Bedford Boys.

"Eighty years ago, brave men knew that evil must be defeated. That is a hero's heart, that is Bedford, that is the Commonwealth of Virginia, and my fellow Americans, that is the United States of America," Youngkin said.

Dear Friend,

Your participation in Hillsdale
College's National Survey on the United States Supreme Court is
requested.

Your response will only take a few
minutes, but the subject is crucial to the future of liberty and
the separation of powers in America.

The American Founders thought that the
proper role of the Supreme Court is to apply the Constitution.

But progressives see the Court
differently. They want activist judges to legislate from the
bench.

Do you agree that the role of the
Supreme Court is to apply the Constitution as it is written and
NOT to make laws or advance a particular policy agenda?

YES

NO

Even worse, progressives dismayed by
recent Supreme Court decisions want to "pack" the bench with
additional justices to advance a preferred policy agenda.

As Sen. Elizabeth Warren (D-Mass.) put
it in a Boston Globe op-ed: "To restore balance and integrity to
a broken institution, Congress must expand the Supreme Court by
four or more seats."

That is why I'm reaching out to you
today...

What is your opinion about the Supreme
Court's role in our constitutional republic?

Please share your thoughts with me
using the College's National Survey on the United States Supreme
Court right away.

Your response will help Hillsdale form
effective strategies to educate millions of Americans about the
importance of the Constitution to liberty-including the proper

## Disney Deal Opens Door for New Park
The proposed $17 billion development agreement between Disney and the state of Florida could lead to a fifth major theme park at the Orlando complex and [includes an $8 billion investment](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxsz71uwyAUQOGnMRsRXH4zMHTJlq4dLWwu8W2xsTCKlT591c6dz3D0fdzHe6RC2-M9rhh6rmOcOz1xtNxz0KNmKWREQMUwSCedN0I5YEswkJ27ajvPIOZJKOWsTtG6PKnrdcqJUQABWljhhTdWq4t1xkvUchIIOjszaIGJem2Xz0pbXzCXV31iu8x1ZSUsve_HoN4GuA1we9D3WlP9bQPczlg6T3Rs-OJnbSXxTLkvvC-4It9j--J7idvBc6mNUuTSG2kAlHWshbSfVAod1g1aPNZI5W_Z__U_A_wEAAD___zcXLc) by Disney in the state's infrastructure. The entertainment company settled its legal battles against Gov. Ron DeSantis and his appointees in March as [negotiations began](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxs0LGSrCAQheGnwQwLWwQTgpuYzU03tFppRnYZsKRXa95-y403O8EJvvo_HvMDY4r5-R9f5DiUGVeOJ81GjhL0rBvvAhFQ35DrbGfHQfUWms2NC-puVdj3HRhtrA3romzQQ1ggaINNdKBAK6NGNQ5G962xw9iR7hZFoIMdhFbkI5ej_Swx80YhvctJR7uWV5PcxrxX0f8TMAmYrutqcVlvXcmZrnq_BEz3FDBVRiYBk48101uu5Tt5WXbKcuBNhlSO6FHueHxJDEyHPAuTvCJv0lPFzLFK3PfbQVSbw_n9iinFaqzQ6vnCmH5Z_Gej08FPAAAA___EYmvd) on the new partnership. As part of the deal, Disney says it will hire over 10,000 new employees over the next decade, invest $10 million in low-cost housing, and spend billions on public improvements. In return for the investment, Disney will be granted the right to add a fifth theme park to the Magic Kingdom, EPCOT, Hollywood Studios, and Animal Kingdom. It also has the right to add hotel rooms and retail and restaurant space.
## New Test Predicts Early Dementia Risk
British scientists say they've developed a new test that can predict [the onset of dementia](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxskLFuhDAQRL_GdD7Zi7G5wkUaukubEhl7udvIYIQ3RPx9RKR0aaaZ0ejpfTzGR6BM6_M9LOh5LmOITAeOVvYSzGia5GdEwLZBr512fadaB83LR4ghRheD1ncbXFIKTactTjBNYKJuyIMCo6zqVd9Z096s63qNRk8KwcyuE0ZhIi777bPQyi-c81kO3G-xLE32L-ativZNwCBgWM-tVL4qAcN1LGBQ9i8yzVj5zHgty4FZMlaWMaxy2zFRZJlwwZUpyK9NcpF3eWLYq5xwLjvKROG5lkpVwNDsPm3flDNV64RRzyVQ_oXifw0dHn4CAAD__8HZZ_0) up to nine years before an official diagnosis is made. In findings published this week, scientists report that their results have been more than 80% accurate, based on comparing their predictions to medical history and data on the patients involved. The model uses [MRI brain scans](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxsz7uOqzAQgOGnMZ3RML5AChenoctpt0QOHsLs-hJhi2zefpWtt_-lT__Hdbl6jpzv_30i17ay-LXxSYuVk0S96C64jQhJdeSGcRgnA2rEbneaLtrCxYA3JqyXm8EVvYINSW1qmNaOHQJqsDDBZKxWvR3NNJAebkCot9EIDRS4laP_LJzbTlt8lZOOfi2pi25v7VGF-idwFjgnCrz6-P04qNZ3IXDO9KwC5zcjwcovzkEGSpQbe_kif1QZ2N9zqVz7vaXYHS48nhwjVzsKDffkOf5y7c_30-FPAAAA__8r2lti) to detect changes in the neural network that are typically the first to be affected by Alzheimer's disease. The scientists say the test can be used to identify people at high risk of dementia.

body:
His signature ability to communicate the truth about Christianity has inspired countless skeptics

This sponsored message from Conservative Broadcast is on behalf of Hillsdale College | | | [](http://post.spmailtechnol.com/f/a/3tbBaUa1DXDF_g1d6rZ9gQ~~/AARclAA~~~)
---
| | Dear Friend, C.S. Lewis was a master at addressing life's most important questions through vivid language that is delightful and captivating to read.

His signature ability to communicate the truth about Christianity has inspired countless skeptics to become believers and even more believers to renew and deepen their faith--making him the greatest Christian apologist of the twentieth century.

That's why we produced "[**C.S. Lewis on Christianity,**](http://post.spmailtechnol.com/f/a/3tbBaUa1DXDF_g1d6rZ9gQ~~/AARclAA~~~)" which you can now own on DVD.
---
| [](http://post.spmailtechnol.com/f/a/3tbBaUa1DXDF_g1d6rZ9gQ~~/AARclAA~~~)
---
| | In this course you will learn Lewis's profound insights on the central topics of Christianity, including:
* good and evil,
* conversion and faith,
* prayer and the Bible,
* suffering and death,
* heaven and hell, and much more.

Dr. Ward is a Distinguished Visiting Professor at Hillsdale College and a member of the Faculty of Theology and Religion at the University of Oxford. He is the author of _Planet Narnia: The Seven Heavens in the Imagination of C.S. Lewis_ and _After Humanity: A Guide to C.S. Lewis 's The Abolition of Man_, and the co-editor of _The Cambridge Companion to C.S. Lewis_. He even spent three years living in Lewis's Oxford home as the resident Warden of The Kilns!

This course is especially moving because it examines C.S. Lewis's beautiful writings about faith and traces Lewis's own journey from skeptic to believer. The combination provides an opportunity for us to grow in our knowledge and understanding of Christianity.

That's why I hope you'll join us in examining the eternal questions of Christianity with C.S. Lewis with [this beautiful DVD box set](http://post.spmailtechnol.com/f/a/3tbBaUa1DXDF_g1d6rZ9gQ~~/AARclAA~~~).

Best regards,

Kyle Murnen, '09
Director of Online Learning
Hillsdale College
---
| |
---

Dear President Trump,

God bless you!

During this dark time for America, we wanted to send you this letter to make sure you feel our love and support.

So let us start by saying, from the bottom of our hearts, THANK YOU!

Thank you for protecting us from the Radical Left hordes that want to destroy our country and our movement.

Thank you for never surrendering to these evil forces that want to destroy America.

And thank you for sacrificing yourself for us.

We know that they are after all of us, but you are selflessly standing in their way.

Thats why:

WE WILL NEVER STOP FIGHTING FOR YOU.

WE WILL NEVER STOP PRAYING FOR YOU.

AND WE WILL NEVER ABANDON YOU.

The Radical Left may have won this battle, but we will win the war.

Because the real verdict will come on November 5th!

During this dark time in America, I hope you feel the love of the millions of patriotic Americans who have your back.

And I hope you know that our movement is more committed than ever to doing everything we can to defeat Joe Biden in November.

Justice will be served. We will make sure of it.

God bless you President Trump, and God help America.

Sincerely,

{YOUR SIGNATURE}

body:
Only a fraction of the 16 million Americans who fought bravely in World War II remain with us.

This sponsored message from Conservative Liberty Wire is on behalf of Hillsdale College
[](https://links.conservativelibertywire.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=20ace57e1a744de29c2695864e85b546&_e=-fqvyRKUtwS1dnGJvGrd0cQilc-fgTWTkPAT2FunsI3PkBQXd0WZHANPFQspMgBnJ9Ua5KHv92yBxZB7dANiGf-I1L-xtARTHXmZF3YQKX4_FYvItoEXRt8-1pGfE3nMfL6ZIRN3TyzfpxBQ_HyDbZUEOUwfGShMVX41RfyKEn5m731cITK2JnN2Df6L30ZUK6qWAcBhxp7lncdcPvSWTdTntM7D3Nr7JLcyDWACpnZQB0m2TrBEFOjYgumI-NRfU_0pB3X35cIsH3KiXcKD830F_WV9DJyLYmHZoqBMsZteDqGRWqvHs85zSBFsTvX2X-9dpRQhJ5eyomAQlbVYqmrxmX-ESOwsKscuAR8AC1XAmeNkcoC0lkf0-szvJefx49xdv8Z2vGuDhzTVPQweEHoJqMzdwx9o2yUR78srgA2qycMNRAwGLblxNOuzoJ11) Dear Fellow American,
Only a fraction of the 16 million Americans who fought bravely in World War II remain with us. This fact means that we're losing more and more living memory of the greatest armed conflict in human history, which makes the study of World War II even more important.
To this end, Hillsdale College has produced an online course called **" The Second World Wars."**
**Taught by historian Victor Davis Hanson** , this course explores how the conflict's diverse theaters, belligerents, and ways of fighting came eventually to define a single war. And it examines the key investments, strategies, and leaders that led the Allied powers to victory over the Axis. I hope you're having a great day so far. I'm reaching out to share something important with you...something that could expand your horizons. I'm talking about studying American history! As Hillsdale College professor Wilfred McClay explains in our online course ["The Great American Story: A Land of Hope,"](http://links.newsletter.conservativedirect.com/u/click?_t=5b1853ae48754bee8f471363fe4933a9&_m=04de4a72f1574d87b700713a618dee2c&_e=jFHLFOHPfQYpAex6O4P3MK3_GRVqA4vX7bzqE6q5zIN0QiJE-J-_9znRvfgoDrEZ36iIb-AD3_z4mJVUWqwaSg0IaA2JvoR7QUCGhHFWnx03fbD-FzuBbuJiagdLs3eme50PIpRdn3pDIEjp_9qgTyCcD9NYsQi2HhJwbBdkGcdy9pEF3c_d4RGkXtZNevjjqguaLrlWtbuQQ-yR7y85LGkhFtrzNF39xaG2Pd1wUyRAW2yUTPwRnCnUZtW8LHOhqrAlb_Lu1TLeNuHqzrfxGx7yUXTvrYeArRoyEzUBqWfQ8HJ4d7HrXttpXqjSgMeGW901-xU5-NQwNJa1M4QB-vLXarv-TKVtMy8F_Kw_G0C-DexwvJMSUTxVAAPU-dWwOkCOi-WJqkdJQDmi_oMane1EVNP8CEoqDIiZZD4tsOo%3D) studying history can broaden your perspective and help you understand different ways of living. Compare that to _The New York Times '_ "1619 Project," now a multi-part series streaming online. The "1619 Project" locates the founding of America in 1619, the year the first slave arrived on our shores, rather than in 1776, when the **Declaration of Independence declared that all men are created equal with unalienable God-given rights**. According to the "1619 Project," the key to understanding America is not freedom but slavery--and the project's main goal is to broadcast this false teaching into every home, including yours. We must counter this false and dishonest historical narrative with the truth. **That 's why we've turned our online course, ["The Great American Story: A Land of Hope,"](http://links.newsletter.conservativedirect.com/u/click?_t=5b1853ae48754bee8f471363fe4933a9&_m=04de4a72f1574d87b700713a618dee2c&_e=jFHLFOHPfQYpAex6O4P3MK3_GRVqA4vX7bzqE6q5zIN0QiJE-J-_9znRvfgoDrEZ36iIb-AD3_z4mJVUWqwaSg0IaA2JvoR7QUCGhHFWnx03fbD-FzuBbuJiagdLs3eme50PIpRdn3pDIEjp_9qgTyCcD9NYsQi2HhJwbBdkGcdy9pEF3c_d4RGkXtZNevjjqguaLrlWtbuQQ-yR7y85LGkhFtrzNF39xaG2Pd1wUyRAW2yUTPwRnCnUZtW8LHOhkRS0bW_vbRNSk9StTN0iPyXGAAEN6fi9DNKzm2N5MMmt5MNmk4ZtVHk2hrbv0oXj2DQZHlCcevSYU_CVPKjAzF_W88vFDTMHfAhDzem3YY0qtyKGGR_Xs7wSzzb3yPh3tw5_5JrqwBNcTEh7RtvLXwlAMK0wTuHaRDMR2QcKvdY%3D) into a DVD set, and I'd like you to have a copy.** **" The Great American Story: A Land of Hope"** presents a full, unbiased account of America's past. We produced this course to restore the kind of intelligent patriotism--especially among our young people--essential to restoring free government. You'll be excited to learn that **" The Great American Story: A Land of Hope"** is a powerful counterweight to _The New York Times '_ "1619 Project," which tells people, especially children, that America is essentially an unjust nation--the opposite of our nation's unifying principles. name: Douglas Carswell
subject: Imagine if Mississippi used our conservative majority?
body:
| | | [View this email in your browser](https://mailchi.mp/mspolicy/successsequence-11572652?e=5703353baa)
---
| |
---
| Dear Friend,

**Before I came to Mississippi, I was a Member of the British Parliament for 12 years for Clacton. **

Donald Trump's friend, Nigel Farage, has now decided to run for election in Clacton on July 4th.
---
|
---
_Nigel Farage and Donald Trump in Mississippi_
| **I'm delighted and I encouraged Nigel to run the moment it was announced that there would be a General Election** (I know, the Brits do politics differently with flexible, rather than fixed, terms). You can read my advice to Nigel on what he needs to do to win [here.](https://mspolicy.us18.list-manage.com/track/click?u=60d4052c66b6745831ccdf7c8&id=1a241461a7&e=5703353baa)
---
|
---
_Nigel Farage is running for election in my old district._
| **Back in the old country, the Conservative party faces annihilation. **

Having sat in office since 2010, Britain’s Conservatives have failed to govern on conservative principles. Today, their supporters are abandoning them for Nigel Farage’s new Reform party.

**_Perhaps this should serve as a stark warning for those who campaign as conservatives, but who govern as progressives._**

Here in Mississippi, Republicans have been in charge since 2011, about as long as Britain’s Conservatives.

**Where are the big strategic changes our state needs?** What reforms are being advanced to elevate Mississippi?

There are, I would suggest, three top challenges Mississippi faces:

* **The state of education:** Sure, there might have been some marginal improvements in standards thanks to the use of phonics. Overall education standards remain poor. Two out of three 4th graders in government schools fail to achieve proficiency in reading or math. **_Almost one in four Mississippi students are chronically absent from school._**

* **Low labor participation:** At a time when millions of migrants are moving to America to work, often illegally, nothing of substance has been done in our state to address the fact that **_48 percent of Mississippi adults of working age are not even active in the labor market._**

* **DEI in state institutions:** Despite having conservatives elected, many of Mississippi’s public institutions, including universities, are run by those beholden to Marxist academic ideology.

**Imagine if we were to use the notionally conservative majority in our state to accomplish actual conservative reforms to tackle any of this? **

Here is a list of some of the bills that were blocked in the most recent legislative session:

* **Ballot initiative** , passed by the House, blocked by the Senate.
* **Anti DEI legislation** , blocked.
* **School choice.** Allow families to choose schools between different districts. Blocked.
* **Healthcare reform. **Repeal intentionally restrictive laws that limit the provision of healthcare. Blocked.

The one big achievement of the session, Rep. Rob Roberson’s INSPIRE bill which personalizes school funding for students, passed because of Speaker White’s drive and determination. Eight weeks ago there were still some in the Senate intent on preserving the old Soviet-era funding formula.

**Morton Blackwell, a great American hero who I happened to meet for tea in Jackson, once said that:**
---
|
---
| He’s right. If we want to see conservative policies implemented in our state, we are going to have to do a lot of pushing!

**Nobody likes to be pushed, particularly politicians.** Leaders will not thank you for making them do something they would preferred not to have done, as my experience with Brexit taught me.

**Here at the Mississippi Center for Public Policy we are 100 percent in the business of pushing for the kind of bold, principled conservative reforms we need.**

We need to start using our conservative majority to deliver the kind of changes we are starting to see in Republican-run states throughout the South.

Have a wonderful weekend!
---
| [Forward this email to a friend!](https://mspolicy.us18.list-manage.com/track/click?u=60d4052c66b6745831ccdf7c8&id=59b6c71a37&e=5703353baa "Forward this email to a friend!")
---
| |
---
Warm regards,

Douglas Carswell
President & CEO

|

subject: What IS lymphedema?!

Over time, these lymphatic channels can break down, age, and congest - rendering them USELESS... _often resulting in swollen tissue around your legs, ankles, and feet._

body:
They lied about

| |
---
| | They lied about the origin of Covid... they lied about the data... and they lied about the science.
---
| |
---
| |
---
[](http://links.reclamingamericanfreedom.com/u/click?_t=5ec072595b1347f09b4bac0de82ea87d&_m=02e56e3e89fe40769a43a1874048f953&_e=zf7eJFdHGiSgzg6V9FpbCe-_oL_R1wys7W2sfR45N3CKyr6_cA3rRMsNgRkE-s9z3hSZFhArVhWhEmLZtn8rK18lmLNkM0AmpXDmTIJ-VI7ZhIHSZcbYhR53iDR2d2ngCuinyucuIAsZly1spn7dCbx4Z2cdu2-gMopszBXHMuO1U9UTJsIyF5GEs7y51pGTrCgoVbRL7d75m90wiCTjBBA3Y8VUXFd9aDrEW3GliZRaqOXuexA-kej33LVGj5s5KA0gS79iK4PUbYyC-19gz-p6n6Ttonb_s9IJf5a8dhq-h8-dnJWXhka8Xh2eQurUYxN3T7MfvGiUW1bJ7keZdSziaZ-G1kyGrQbNC-a4r1ND5pGqJeT0kpnbMJgkud89lZZwNsQz8PRxpNt3vzt7tg%3D%3D)
---
| | Friend, They lied about the origin of Covid... they lied about the data... and they lied about the science. They called you a conspiracy theorist, accused you of spreading misinformation and even banned you from social media. They said it was OK for you to shop at big box stores and participate in race riots - while they closed down your church, small businesses and schools. And then they demanded that you take an experimental vaccine if you wanted to travel, go out in public, or even keep your job. Millions of Americans reluctantly complied even though they felt like this was a violation of their bodily autonomy - and in some case, their religious beliefs. **Tens of thousands of hardworking Americans refused to give in and were fired when they refused to get the Covid shot.** Doctors, nurses, teachers, members of the military, and many more. And now that we know more of the truth about Covid, the vaccine, and the shady collusion between government organizations, Big Tech and Big Pharma... ...they'd love nothing more than to sweep this all under the rug and pretend it never happened. **That 's why I've instructed our attorneys at the Center for American Liberty to continue legal action to hold them accountable.** For starters, we filed a lawsuit against the North Carolina Symphony on behalf of three musicians fired for refusing to get the COVID vaccine. _Each of them had been employed by the_ _ __Symphony_ _ __for over 10 years._ [**And if we can win this critical legal battle, we can put employers across the country on notice that they should reinstate victims of their COVID vaccine firings.**](http://links.reclamingamericanfreedom.com/u/click?_t=5ec072595b1347f09b4bac0de82ea87d&_m=02e56e3e89fe40769a43a1874048f953&_e=zf7eJFdHGiSgzg6V9FpbCe-_oL_R1wys7W2sfR45N3CKyr6_cA3rRMsNgRkE-s9z3hSZFhArVhWhEmLZtn8rK18lmLNkM0AmpXDmTIJ-VI7ZhIHSZcbYhR53iDR2d2ngCuinyucuIAsZly1spn7dCbx4Z2cdu2-gMopszBXHMuO1U9UTJsIyF5GEs7y51pGTrCgoVbRL7d75m90wiCTjBBA3Y8VUXFd9aDrEW3GliZRaqOXuexA-kej33LVGj5s533UhYSmRb5IVygHD2c2eHTrzNfeGInNO1wYcqbGacccwm5YbNELHFzfQkHNnfvZV7vNdr_MRhkYvRrR31ANlmDT6zl8x55D929tttcdN0N4WzBGNfmNhb_IV7c0C1y50-wtC6w590SJoM9YyS823gw%3D%3D) When the Symphony first introduced its vaccine mandate, it offered both religious and medical exemptions. Dovid, Chris, and Rachel filed for religious exemptions, and expressed a willingness to take other measures--like regular COVID testing--to ensure safety. But the Symphony rejected ALL of them and put them on a year of UNPAID LEAVE. These three musicians were Buddhist, Christian and Jewish. **To you and me, the freedom to practice your religion is a sacred right.** **So is your right to bodily autonomy.** But in the eyes of the cultural Marxists who control so many institutions in America today, your body doesn't belong to you - it belongs to them. They'll decide where you go... They'll decide what you need... They'll decide what you can have... They'll decide what vaccines you must take... In other words: _Your individual liberties_ will cease to exist. The good news is that while cultural Marxism is booming on college campuses and inside government bureaucracies... ...the vast majority of Americans are against it. This is a fight we can win - and we must win. [**You can join me today by making a generous, tax-deductible donation to the Center for American Liberty to fund this lawsuit for medical and religious freedom, and set a precedent nationwide that puts these radicals on notice.**](http://links.reclamingamericanfreedom.com/u/click?_t=5ec072595b1347f09b4bac0de82ea87d&_m=02e56e3e89fe40769a43a1874048f953&_e=zf7eJFdHGiSgzg6V9FpbCe-_oL_R1wys7W2sfR45N3CKyr6_cA3rRMsNgRkE-s9z3hSZFhArVhWhEmLZtn8rK18lmLNkM0AmpXDmTIJ-VI7ZhIHSZcbYhR53iDR2d2ngCuinyucuIAsZly1spn7dCbx4Z2cdu2-gMopszBXHMuO1U9UTJsIyF5GEs7y51pGTrCgoVbRL7d75m90wiCTjBBA3Y8VUXFd9aDrEW3GliZRaqOXuexA-kej33LVGj5s5JkO5YPLvcnRUPDWYphRGeturVIbY58TrKGuG2I0bOnZOTKy7gNifvZiRuapZluEh2qNO4iBhiGyweC8qFq_llpYFRLlk-Coqv0aj3O5nMxLG7S4N4dQl-Qlb0mV2S2-mGfbcVb71Dz2sao061ISHJg%3D%3D) Even after the North Carolina Symphony lifted its vaccine mandate, it refused to give these musicians their jobs back. Because it was never about "science" or "health" - it was always about control. And it's time to tell the cultural Marxists who want to control every aspect of your life that we aren't backing down. I hope I can count on your support.
---
| | Sincerely,

I want to take a moment to thank you.

You don’t hear that enough in these emails. You do SO MUCH for this team, and we wouldn’t have gotten this far without you.

Your contributions and prayers mean the world to my family and me. I truly cannot begin to express how grateful I am.

Right now, I’m in the fight of my life. I’m up against one of the most well-connected Democrats in politics, and he’s raking in millions from every megadonor from Silicon Valley to K Street.

_Our campaign is different._ We’re fueled by grassroots patriots like you, and that means we really rely on your contributions, no matter how big or small they are.

_And now, we’re coming up on our biggest test yet._

Our primary is just _days_ away, and we’re the only Republican in this race with a fighting chance of taking on Tim Kaine.

That’s why the political elite are so determined to make sure we don’t win this primary, Peter.

# FROM THE DESK OF ALAN DERSHOWITZ
---
| | Dear Reader, In over sixty years in the legal profession, I've experienced first hand the impact of both good journalism and bad journalism — mostly the latter — and just how important and rare it is to get things right.

**In today's media landscape there are far too many publications that get things wrong.** Many are more concerned with the political implications of a story than the basic facts.

**The New York Sun is different.** It's a paper that places principle over politics and people over party.

Its in-depth coverage of the legal challenges faced by President Trump serve as a case in point.

When I defended President Trump during his first impeachment, I faced an avalanche of criticism, but few papers made sufficient effort to fully appreciate the significance of the legal arguments.

The Sun's deeply knowledgeable leadership, including its editor Seth Lipsky and associate editor A.R. Hoffman are themselves students of the Constitution. It shows in their coverage, which I find to be first rate.

It will be no secret to you that I don't agree with everything that can be found in the Sun's pages, but I can say with confidence that its re-emergence is among the most important recent developments in American journalism.

I've been impressed by the Sun's growth so far, but I know it faces an uphill battle, one that I have pledged to join.

**The Sun's success will be a gift to the American people and to the cause of truth.** But to succeed, we need you to join us. I highly encourage you to join the Sun today.

Every person matters in this effort.

Don't wait. The battle to restore American journalism starts now.

body:
# [](https://act.elissaslotkin.org/go/188?t=1&akid=1511%2E135344%2EkzJjKC)

Sometimes people don’t believe it, but it’s the reality: TV advertising matters.
TV ads are a big part of the exposure that most voters will get to a political campaign. And Michiganders still tend to watch a lot of TV -- especially seniors. TV ads are also expensive, and consequently, TV ends up being a big part of most campaigns’ budgets.
It’s doubly true in Michigan, where we have 11 media markets to reach and one of the most expensive media markets in the country in Detroit.
But not all TV ads are created equal. There are a couple of ways to secure that critical airtime at a lower rate.
The first variable is _when_ you reserve ad time. Ad rates are constantly fluctuating depending on demand. As you might imagine, by October there will be a lot of demand for the airwaves as political spenders flood the state in advance of the November general election. Reserving that time early can save a campaign hundreds of thousands of dollars -- if they have the cash early enough to do it.
The second variable is _who_ reserves that ad time. The FCC guarantees that candidates can buy TV ads at the lowest rate during certain windows in the lead-up to an election. Outside political groups, meanwhile, can be charged at the higher rates.
So while we know these groups are prepared to spend millions of dollars on attack ads against Elissa -- and that our best line of defense is sharing Elissa’s positive message by keeping our own ads on the air -- we know that our money can be stretched a little further, especially if we can reserve ads as early as possible.
So why don’t campaigns buy all of their TV reservations five months or even a year out? The answer is money -- while donations are most useful early in the campaign, contributions tend to come in towards the very end of the campaign. That’s why launching our TV ads early was a bit of a risk, and why your support now is so beneficial to our campaign’s efforts to reach voters all the way through Election Day.

Curtis Bashaw

Republican Nominee, United States Senate

\*\*_GET TO KNOW CURTIS_\*\*

\*\*Curtis Bashaw is a hotel entrepreneur, job creator, and preservationist. He's running for United States Senate to provide greater freedom and opportunities for all New Jerseyans.\*\*

A lifelong New Jersey resident, Curtis grew up in Camden County and spent his summers at the Jersey Shore working as a bellhop and waiting tables at Congress Hall in Cape May. He has spent his life in the real estate and hospitality industries, and is the Founder and Managing Partner of Cape Resorts, a hotel company focusing on the restoration and operation of classic American resort properties in New Jersey and New York.

Throughout his career, Curtis has worked to build communities and bring people together. He is widely recognized for leading the landmark restorations of Congress Hall and the Virginia Hotel in Cape May, and for launching creative programming to dramatically extend Cape May's season, a catalyst for the economic rebirth of one of the Jersey Shore's most beautiful communities.

Curtis is a successful businessman and job creator, employing more than 1,000 people in New Jersey and New York. Curtis' company owns and operates eight hotels, ten cottages, six restaurants, four retail outlets and a working farm, all on the Jersey Shore and Long Island's East End. Curtis lives in Cape May with his husband, Will.

body:
Happy Pride Month!

[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/86515198/478120111/950179054?refcode=EM_C_240608Pride_N_SB_90DO_6_NG_N_Logo&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMjEvMS84Nzg0NCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIxOTNkODg0ZS05ZDI1LWVmMTEtODZkMi02MDQ1YmRkOWUwOTYiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=QDcj36LSn-uvpqedNd2QMfAz485WgEoW7nLl4U7D0Rw=) Peter – Happy Pride Month! 🏳️🌈

This month, and always, we celebrate the LGBTQ+ community. **In a month of pride, it’s essential to acknowledge the grit and determination it took to get here.**

In December, Ohio’s Governor vetoed a measure that would have banned gender-affirming care for minors in our state. Unfortunately,**the veto was overridden by the Republican-controlled Ohio Senate. **Discriminatory state bills like HB 68 _emphasize_ the need for additional federal legislation to protect the rights of LGBTQ+ people nationwide.

**The LGBTQ+ continues to face discriminatory bills every single day. As a member of the Congressional Equality Caucus, I will continue to fight for the rights of LGBTQ+ Ohioans and legislation to ensure equality and freedom from discrimination.**

This month is about celebrating love in all its forms – regardless of gender identity, sexual orientation, or pronouns.

**Together, let's fight against violence and discrimination and work towards a future where justice and equality are the norm for all.**

Onward and Happy Pride,

Shontel Brown | As a Cuyahoga County Council member and Chairwoman of the Cuyahoga County Democratic Party, Shontel Brown has spent the last decade serving the people of Ohio and building coalitions. Now, as the Congresswoman for Ohio’s 11th District, she will fight for affordable quality health care, jobs that pay fair wages, a strong public education system, and equity and justice for all. **Will you join her and be the change we need?**

name: Debbie Mucarsel-Powell
subject: Rick Scott could be our next Senate leader
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR BY BOB CASEY FOR SENATE INC
body:
Peter — when I saw this news, I was sick to my stomach:
[](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/casey-em-20240608-1?refcode=em20240608-1&refcode2=3193_552475_Ew7WiL&akid=3193%2E552475%2EEw7WiL)
This means my race to retire Rick Scott could decide BOTH the Senate majority and the majority leader.
If we thought the current GOP Senate leadership was bad, we really don't want the guy whose agenda was _too extreme for Mitch McConnell_ to take his place. He already laid out his plan for the country:
❌Pass a national abortion ban
❌End Medicare and Social Security
❌Raise taxes on the middle class
**Now more than ever, it is vital that we kick him to the curb this November.**
[**So please, Peter, we need to raise $250,000 by midnight to make sure this nightmare won't come true. I'm counting on you to do your part before 11:59 p.m. and split $5 or anything you can between****Bob Casey****and my campaign to help me flip Florida blue, defend our Democratic majority, and block a Rick Scott-led Senate.**](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/casey-em-20240608-1?refcode=em20240608-1&refcode2=3193_552475_Ew7WiL&akid=3193%2E552475%2EEw7WiL)
**[Donate ››](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/casey-em-20240608-1?refcode=em20240608-1&recurring=1&refcode2=3193_552475_Ew7WiL&akid=3193%2E552475%2EEw7WiL)**
**Make no mistake: Mitch McConnell's time as Senate GOP leader was one of the worst things to ever happen to the Senate.** It will take years for our country and our democracy to fully recover from his decades of corruption, cronyism, extremism, and obstruction.
**_But Rick Scott as Senate GOP leader would be much, much worse._**
He oversaw one of the biggest Medicare frauds in U.S. history and used the money to buy his seat. Then he wrote the plan to raise taxes on working families and end Medicare and Social Security. THEN, he co-sponsored a nationwide ban on abortions. All that destruction and he's only been in the Senate for a single term. **Imagine what he could do as GOP Leader.**
In short — Rick Scott shouldn't be allowed to step foot in the U.S. Senate, let alone lead the GOP caucus, whether they have the majority or not.
But with McConnell out of the way, Scott is under the impression that this will be an easy win. **I need your help to prove him wrong.**
**This is a make-or-break moment not just for my campaign but for our entire country.[My team set a $250,000 emergency fundraising goal to make sure we never see a Rick Scott-led Senate, and it will take each and every one of us doing our part to hit it. I'm hoping I can count on you to split just $5 between Bob Casey and my campaign to make sure we don't fall short so we can defeat Rick Scott.](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/casey-em-20240608-1?refcode=em20240608-1&refcode2=3193_552475_Ew7WiL&akid=3193%2E552475%2EEw7WiL)**
**[Donate Now ››](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/casey-em-20240608-1?refcode=em20240608-1&refcode2=3193_552475_Ew7WiL&akid=3193%2E552475%2EEw7WiL)**
Let's do this.
Debbie Mucarsel-Powell

name: Elizabeth Warren
subject: The truth about Red Lobster
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Warren for Senate
body:
I’ve introduced the most comprehensive bill to tackle this issue.

| | | [ ](https://act.elizabethwarren.com/go/216?t=3&akid=2201%2E4032634%2E1vgtH0)
---
Don’t blame it on the endless shrimp. Recently, Red Lobster declared bankruptcy, and even though it’s no laughing matter, the jokes practically wrote themselves — _how could a company that offers endless shrimp NOT run out of money?_ But if you look right beneath the surface, you’ll see Red Lobster’s real downfall wasn’t endless shrimp — it was private equity’s endless greed. You see, a private equity firm bought Red Lobster in 2014, and did their thing: Looted profits, loaded Red Lobster up with debt, and saddled the restaurant chain with extra real-estate costs — following a model that reaps rewards for private equity owners but leaves communities, workers, and customers holding the bag. Now, even though Red Lobster is a recent example of this blood-sucking phenomenon, **private equity’s harmful effects go far, far beyond the restaurant industry** — from retail stores to nursing homes to fisheries to manufactured housing communities to hospital systems (including Steward Health Care in Massachusetts). **Private equity should not be allowed to loot one business after another, and I have introduced the most comprehensive bill to overhaul the private equity industry.** My Stop Wall Street Looting Act would put private investment fund managers on the hook for the companies they control, end looting, empower workers and investors, and safeguard the markets from risky corporate debt. But it’ll be an uphill battle to overcome the powerful interests who want to preserve a status quo that means big profits for them — even as stores get closed, consumers get cheated, workers get laid off, and pensions get raided. [**Say you’re in this fight to stop private equity from ransacking our economy, and sign on as a grassroots co-sponsor of my Stop Wall Street Looting Act.**](https://act.elizabethwarren.com/signup/ew-em-contraceptionact/?source=EMZ20R_FIN_E_20240608_V1S1&t=8&akid=2201%2E4032634%2E1vgtH0) | [**ADD YOUR NAME**](https://act.elizabethwarren.com/signup/ew-em-contraceptionact/?source=EMZ20R_FIN_E_20240608_V1S1&t=9&akid=2201%2E4032634%2E1vgtH0)
---
Here are a few big pieces of what my Stop Wall Street Looting Act would accomplish:
* Fundamentally reform the industry by closing the legal, tax, and regulatory loopholes that allow private equity firms to capture all the rewards of their investments while insulating themselves from risk.
* Require private investment firms, the firm’s general partners, and their insiders to share responsibility for the liabilities of companies under their control — including debt, legal judgments and pension-related obligations — to better align the incentives of private equity firms and the companies they own.
* Ban dividends to investors and the outsourcing of jobs for two years after a firm is acquired — ending the extraction of resources from acquired companies.
* Prevent private equity firms from walking away when a company fails and protect workers by improving rules so workers are more likely to receive severance and pensions in a bankruptcy.
* Require private equity managers to disclose fees, returns, and other information about their funds so that investors can monitor their investments and shop around.
* Reinstate Dodd-Frank provisions that require regulators to address risky leverage.

**Big private equity firms have fat profits on the line here, so they’ll do everything they can to block our reforms. That means we can win only if we link arms, raise our voices together, and fight from the heart.**
[**Add your name here to say you support my Stop Wall Street Looting Act, and side by side, we’ll tackle the private equity industry’s abuses.**](https://act.elizabethwarren.com/signup/ew-em-contraceptionact/?source=EMZ20R_FIN_E_20240608_V1S1&t=10&akid=2201%2E4032634%2E1vgtH0)
Thanks for being a part of this,
Elizabeth

body:

| | |
---
[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/86517353/478126833/691330008?amounts=250,100,50,25,5&refcode=jtk1948-fr-nd&recurring=1&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTMvMS84NzY0NSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI2MDIxYTMxYi1hMDI1LWVmMTEtODZkMi02MDQ1YmRkOWUwOTYiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=Tjh02QUfyy7JWKaNbp5kC3W-C3K53KMzmzuxP0_1CFY=)
Friend, I’m Jim Obergefell – a proud Ohioan, gay man, and civil rights activist. If my name sounds familiar, it’s probably because of the landmark Obergefell v. Hodges Supreme Court case.
I still remember that humid day on June 26, 2015, when the Court came to order and Justice Kennedy started reading the decision. When I realized we’d won and that marriage was now legal for LGBTQ+ couples across the country, I burst into tears, as did many others in the room.
**For the first time in my life as an out gay man, I felt like an equal American.**
It was such a hopeful moment for our country – and I’m still hopeful because I know there are leaders like my friend Sen. Sherrod Brown who are fighting for our rights and pushing for progress.
But I’m also worried. Thanks to Donald Trump and Mitch McConnell, we now have a conservative supermajority on the Supreme Court – one that, if given the chance again, would very likely not rule in our favor on marriage equality. They’ve already overturned Roe v. Wade and ruled that businesses can discriminate against same-sex couples. I’m fearful of what they’ll do next.
**Our best hope is to elect leaders who will fight for our rights at every level of government, and Ohioans have no greater champion than Sherrod Brown. He’s spent his whole life fighting for equality, and I’m proud to call him my senator. **
**[**_That’s why I’m personally asking you to join me in supporting his reelection campaign by chipping in $5 or $25 today._**](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/86517354/478126834/691330008?amounts=250,100,50,25,5&refcode=jtk1948-fr-nd&recurring=1&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTMvMS84NzY0NSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI2MDIxYTMxYi1hMDI1LWVmMTEtODZkMi02MDQ1YmRkOWUwOTYiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=Tjh02QUfyy7JWKaNbp5kC3W-C3K53KMzmzuxP0_1CFY=)**
Sherrod is facing his toughest reelection yet, and his opponent, Bernie Moreno, is straight out of the MAGA playbook, meaning he’d vote to roll back all our progress.

clean_body: Protecting this seat must be a priority for anyone that cares about equality in America. | | | = Friend, I’m Jim Obergefell – a proud Ohioan, gay man, and civil rights activist. If my name sounds familiar, it’s probably because of the landmark Obergefell v. Hodges Supreme Court case. I still remember that humid day on June 26, 2015, when the Court came to order and Justice Kennedy started reading the decision. When I realized we’d won and that marriage was now legal for LGBTQ+ couples across the country, I burst into tears, as did many others in the room. For the first time in my life as an out gay man, I felt like an equal American. It was such a hopeful moment for our country – and I’m still hopeful because I know there are leaders like my friend Sen. Sherrod Brown who are fighting for our rights and pushing for progress. But I’m also worried. Thanks to Donald Trump and Mitch McConnell, we now have a conservative supermajority on the Supreme Court – one that, if given the chance again, would very likely not rule in our favor on marriage equality. They’ve already overturned Roe v. Wade and ruled that businesses can discriminate against same-sex couples. I’m fearful of what they’ll do next. Our best hope is to elect leaders who will fight for our rights at every level of government, and Ohioans have no greater champion than Sherrod Brown. He’s spent his whole life fighting for equality, and I’m proud to call him my senator. = Sherrod is facing his toughest reelection yet, and his opponent, Bernie Moreno, is straight out of the MAGA playbook, meaning he’d vote to roll back all our progress. name: Justice Democrats
subject: These are Trump-era immigration policies
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR BY JUSTICE DEMOCRATS
body:
[1]Justice Democrats

This week, President Biden issued a disappointing and disturbing executive
order on immigration that the ACLU says, “will severely restrict people's
legal right to seek asylum, putting tens of thousands of lives at
risk," Peter.

The order will shut down asylum requests at the U.S.-Mexico border if/when
undocumented crossings average 2,500 per day. President Biden is also
cutting down the minimum amount of time migrants have to consult an
attorney from 24 hours to only 4 hours — going even further than Trump’s
former policy.

These Trump-era limitations on asylum seekers will only result in more
deportations and harm to migrants fleeing violence and seeking a better
life for their families. [ https://go.justicedemocrats.com/sign/petition_20240608_immigration/?source=em20240608-35191&akid=35191%2E1203867%2ER8-8Fa ]Sign our petition to oppose this misguided
executive order now!

Four years ago, President Biden campaigned on ending Donald Trump’s cruel,
dehumanizing immigration policies. This attempt to win over conservative
voters ahead of November’s election is a major step backward and
completely out of line with our Democratic values.

We agree with Representatives Ayanna Pressley and Delia Ramirez, who
joined other Justice Democrats incumbents in speaking out against this:

[ https://go.justicedemocrats.com/sign/petition_20240608_immigration/?source=em20240608-35191&akid=35191%2E1203867%2ER8-8Fa ]@RepPressley: Asylum is a human right. And we should NOT be doubling
down on Trump’s harmful & flawed immigration policies. @POTUS must reverse
course.

[ https://go.justicedemocrats.com/sign/petition_20240608_immigration/?source=em20240608-35191&akid=35191%2E1203867%2ER8-8Fa ]@repdeliaramirez: Deterrence has never worked. We must #SaveAsylum.
Standing with my immigrant mother, advocates, and Members of Congress, I
am calling for executive orders that honor people’s humanity, keep
families together, and extend work permits for all. @POTUS, we need
relief!

[ https://go.justicedemocrats.com/sign/petition_20240608_immigration/?source=em20240608-35191&akid=35191%2E1203867%2ER8-8Fa ]President Biden must reverse course, save asylum, and pursue humane
immigration reform. If you agree, add your name to our petition now to
build the pressure →

[ https://go.justicedemocrats.com/sign/petition_20240608_immigration/?source=em20240608-35191&akid=35191%2E1203867%2ER8-8Fa ]Add Your Name

Let’s make it clear: The Democratic Party should never sacrifice the
dignity and human rights of migrants to score political points from the
right.

In solidarity,

Justice Democrats

subject: 🎉 Wish Gabby Giffords a happy birthday! 🎉
disclaimer_text: Paid For By Giffords PAC; not authorized by any candidate or candidate's committee
body:
Because of Gabby and the work we’ve done together, there are people alive today celebrating their own birthdays.
#

Friends -
Today is Gabby Giffords’ birthday! It’s a special day for Gabby, her friends and family, all of us here at GIFFORDS, and supporters like you.
As we mark another year gone by, we’re reminded of just how lucky we are that Gabby devotes herself each and every day to the lifesaving work of ending gun violence in our nation. Gabby has never given up in her own recovery or in the fight to change our nation’s gun laws. Her hope and perseverance serves as an inspiration to us all.
Because of Gabby and the work we’ve done together, there are people alive today celebrating their own birthdays. Isn’t that something truly special?
But there’s still so much more work to be done. Gun violence is still a crisis in our nation, and Gabby isn’t going to rest until we see the day where everyone, no matter who they are or where they live, is safe from the threat of gun violence.
[**In honor of Gabby’s birthday, will you make a $3 donation to GIFFORDS PAC today? Her birthday wish is to keep up our momentum in the fight to make our communities safer from gun violence, and our ability to do this work depends on supporters like you.**](https://go.giffords.org/go/14457?c0=giffords-em-june24.gd3XnS&refcode=em240608-1-30&t=1&akid=8267%2E3935704%2E98tJ9U)

**[DONATE TO GIFFORDS](https://go.giffords.org/go/14457?c0=giffords-em-june24.gd3XnS&refcode=em240608-1-30&t=3&akid=8267%2E3935704%2E98tJ9U)**

I was recently visiting with my 95-year old father (his name is Ed, and he lives in sunny Boca Raton, so he is known as BocaEddy) and he reminded me about a photo that — well I just _had_ to share it with you.
Here you go. Me at 13, in all my “glory” at my Bar Mitzvah:
[](https://click.everyaction.com/k/86518729/478130258/443154033?amount=3&refcode=UTS_FR_90DO_240608_2_1&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9FQS9FQTAwNy8xLzg5NDc2IiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogImJkMGMwNzRjLWEyMjUtZWYxMS04NmQyLTYwNDViZGQ5ZTA5NiIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=J2J5BrZsPTHZO_L77up1Z4eQ1FFFc_gDSir3FgIUvhM=)

Throughout my career in public service, I’ve thought a lot about the Jewish tradition of “Tikkun Olam,” or repairing the world. And over the last few years, there has been a lot that was broken, and a lot to fix. It’s been my cause.

I want to take you back to 1973. Our family moved around a lot because my father was in the “schmata” business. He started as a traveling salesman, and later worked as a regional manager for a men’s clothing company.
We moved from Massachusetts where I was born, lived a few years in Arizona, and ended up in the Bay Area. It was there where my dad got out of the clothing business and bought a lumber yard, where I worked during the summers. There’s nothing like hauling sheets of plywood and roofing, and shoveling concrete to make you want to go to graduate school.
This photo was taken when my family was a member of Temple Isaiah in Lafayette, California, a reform synagogue we joined after moving to the Bay Area. And it came after months of practicing for my Bar Mitzvah. I even taped my practice sessions on our tape recorder (I have a copy of that tape somewhere, believe it or not, voice cracking and all.)
While the Hebrew language skills I quickly acquired were just as quickly lost, the lessons that my faith taught me endure and guide me to this day.
**In fact, my favorite passage comes from Micah: What is required of us, but to do justice, to love mercy, and to walk humbly with thy God.**
These principles have guided my work in Congress. They have led me to pursue criminal justice reform, to make housing the homeless a key priority, to attack discrimination, and to ensure the rule of law is applied equally. They have also guided my path as I held accountable and stood up to the most unscrupulous man to ever occupy the Oval Office.
And they guide me in the fight we face today: repairing and rebuilding our democracy so that we leave it better for my children and yours.
That’s why I put everything I have into my work in Congress and for the cause of our democracy. It’s the first thing I think about when I wake up in the morning, and I don’t rest until I’ve done all I can for the day.

It’s official: We’re facing off against Mitch McConnell’s handpicked candidate Tim Sheehy in one of 2024’s most important Senate races. This is the most critical moment of our campaign so far. How we respond now will determine whether we’re able to defend this seat or allow some wealthy outsider to buy it out from under us. Tim Sheehy has been lying to Montanans, and I’m sick of it. He’s been trying to trick Montanans into believing that he grew up rural when he actually grew up in a multi-million-dollar lakehouse. He’s just another wealthy outsider buying up Montana and making things more expensive for the rest of us. | Peter,

There are very few American politicians who are worthy of our trust...

Joe Biden and Kamala Harris campaigned on the promise to “ _Build Back Better_.” As a result, we have an illegal invasion at the southern border, skyrocketing inflation, and America-Last foreign policy that’s sending BILLIONS of our hard-earned money overseas.

Barack Obama campaigned on the promise of “ _Change_.” As a result, we became more divided as a nation, healthcare became more expensive, and our American values were thrown to the wayside.

President Donald Trump promised to “ _**Make America Great Again**_ ,” and that’s exactly what he did. Unemployment rates dropped, fuel and groceries were affordable, illegal immigration was under control, and Americans were prospering for the first time in nearly a decade.

It’s time to elect candidates we know and trust. With your support, I will work with President Donald Trump to finish building the wall and restore America’s greatness.

We have a real opportunity to undo the damages of the rogue Biden regime and take America back while we still have a country to save.

We know what President Trump is capable of. With real America-First conservative Republicans in Congress supporting his agenda, we will be able to achieve so much more.

This is our opportunity to do what’s right for our children and for our country. America’s future is in our hands, and we must take action before it’s too late.

body:
[ stdin# ][IMG]

INSIDER NEWS FROM THE FRONTLINES OF THE POLITICAL REVOLUTION

--------------------------------------------------------------------------

HEADLINES: Fight for the Future Town Hall This Monday! | Progressive
Leaders Convene at Sanders Gathering | Endorsements: AOC and VT Climate
Champs | Victories in DC and Texas! | & MORE!

★ ★ ★

[ https://act.ourrevolution.com/go/17429?t=1011&akid=6138%2E5885482%2Eg0wxVe ]Donate to Our Revolution today — or sign up for a monthly donation — to
help us defeat Trump, elect progressives, and advance the push for Peace.

★ ★ ★

[ https://act.ourrevolution.com/go/17998?t=1012&akid=6138%2E5885482%2Eg0wxVe ][IMG]

Don’t miss Our Revolution’s Fight for the Future Town Hall, LIVE this
Monday with U.S. Rep. Jamaal Bowman, Vermont Lt. Gov. David Zuckerman,
Vermont Rep. Emilie Krasnow, and Rev. Lennox Yearwood Jr. of the Hip Hop
Caucus!

Join us as we organize to re-elect these inspiring climate champions and
talk with Rev. Yearwood about the next phase of the fight against fossil
fuels. RSVP now and we’ll send you a Zoom link to join the conversation at
8:30 pm ET / 5:30 PT on Monday!

[ https://act.ourrevolution.com/go/17998?t=1013&akid=6138%2E5885482%2Eg0wxVe ]RSVP HERE

★ ★ ★

★ ★ ★

Our Revolution leaders joined with some of the country’s top progressive
minds at [ https://act.ourrevolution.com/go/17999?t=1014&akid=6138%2E5885482%2Eg0wxVe ]The Sanders Institute Gathering last weekend — including
Bernie and Jane Sanders, Bill McKibben, Ben Jealous, and many others — to
talk about next steps in our fight to make our progressive policy
priorities a reality.

Our Revolution Executive Director Joseph Geevarghese led a panel about
Taking on Big Oil: Ending Fossil Fuel Subsidies with Rev. Lennox Yearwood
Jr. of the Hip Hop Caucus, Jamie Minden of Zero Hour and Erich Picha of
Friends of the Earth.

“Our democracy is on the line. But so too is the fate of our planet,” Our
Revolution Executive Director Joseph Geevarghese [ https://act.ourrevolution.com/go/18000?t=1015&akid=6138%2E5885482%2Eg0wxVe ]told the panel.
“Bernie recently introduced the End Polluter Welfare Act to close their
tax loopholes and phase out the tax subsidies to Big Oil. We need a
movement to get this over the finish line.”

[ https://act.ourrevolution.com/go/18001?t=1016&akid=6138%2E5885482%2Eg0wxVe ]Common Dreams reported on the panel and the next phase of the fight
against the fossil fuel industry in its piece this week titled, ‘Time to
Go for the Jugular': Climate Movement Has New Plan to Destroy Big Oil.

Americans are not only “dying because of the climate crisis” but also
paying fossil fuel companies “to kill us,” Rev. Yearwood told the
audience. “Their business plan literally means a death sentence for our
communities.” Hear more from Rev. Yearwood on our [ https://act.ourrevolution.com/go/17998?t=1017&akid=6138%2E5885482%2Eg0wxVe ]Fight for the Future
Town Hall on Monday!

John Nichols of The Nation discussed the Role of the Media in Effecting
Change with David Sirota of The Lever and Jon Queally of Common Dreams.
Stephanie Kelton, a senior economic adviser to Bernie in his 2020
campaign, introduced her new film: Finding the Money.

On the topic of Fighting for the Working Class, we heard from Sara Nelson
- Int’l President of the Association of Flight Attendants CWA, AFL-CIO -
and Saru Jayaraman, President of One Fair Wage.

“Starbucks baristas did us a huge favor by organizing when many people
said it was not strategic,” Sara told the crowd. “Corporate elite tell us
you should feel lucky to have a job. We're gonna make sure they know they
should feel lucky to have our work!”

Wendell Potter, author and whistleblower, spoke on the HealthCare Crisis,
and a host of other speakers dug into key progressive priorities ranging
from the Housing Crisis to Social Security.

★ ★ ★

Mark your calendar for June 11th, and join us LIVE to discuss Worker
Organizing with the Economic Policy Institute and new developments at the
National Labor Relations Board.

NLRB General Counsel Jennifer Abruzzo will give us a breakdown on all the
major reforms her office has undertaken. And, Our Revolution Chair Larry
Cohen - former President of the Communications Workers of America - will
join her on a panel to discuss their impact on workplace organizing.

We’ll learn about the measures the NLRB has taken to support worker
organizing and bargaining rights under the Biden administration, and hear
from Cindy Estrada, Strategic Advisor to the President for the Center for
Transformational Organizing, AFL-CIO.

[ https://act.ourrevolution.com/go/18002?t=1018&akid=6138%2E5885482%2Eg0wxVe ]RSVP here to join at 2pm EST/11am PST on June 11th and lift up the
fight for worker power!

★ ★ ★

★ ★ ★

Right wing billionaires, corporate cronies, AIPAC, and MAGA donors are
pouring millions into Democratic primaries trying to unseat some of our
top progressive champions in Congress.

Our Revolution and the grassroots progressive movement are rallying to
out-organize the Big Money. This means speaking directly to voters by
phone banks, online outreach, and knocking doors.

In the upcoming primary contests, we refuse to let powerful voices like
Rashida Tlaib, Ilhan Omar, Cori Bush, Jamaal Bowman and others be silenced
by the donor class. We will fight for democracy!

[ https://act.ourrevolution.com/go/16898?t=1019&akid=6138%2E5885482%2Eg0wxVe ]DONATE TO HELP US DEFEND AND EXPAND PROGRESSIVE POWER IN CONGRESS IN
2024

★ ★ ★

Our Revolution is once again endorsing Alexandria Ocasio-Cortez for
re-election to Congress in NY-14!

AOC continues to be a powerful voice for our progressive priorities from
ending student debt to Medicare for All to the Green New Deal.

She has been an outspoken advocate for a Ceasefire and Peace in Gaza. With
right wing and corporate money pouring into the race, it’s critical that
our grassroots movement do everything we can to keep her in office!

★ ★ ★

Our Revolution is happy to stand with David Zuckerman in his run for
re-election as Lt. Governor of Vermont!

David has been a lifelong ally of Bernie Sanders as well as an organic
farmer, environmentalist, and champion for the working class.

We look forward to hearing from him on our [ https://act.ourrevolution.com/go/17998?t=1020&akid=6138%2E5885482%2Eg0wxVe ]LIVE Call Monday about his
work to advance climate action and hold Big Oil to account in the Green
Mountain State, where fossil fuel companies can no longer pollute with
impunity! Read more about the new legislation to do just that in
[ https://act.ourrevolution.com/go/18003?t=1021&akid=6138%2E5885482%2Eg0wxVe ]Rolling Stone.

★ ★ ★

Our Revolution is excited to endorse State Rep. Emilie Krasnow for
re-election in Vermont, where she has been a powerful champion for
climate, housing, healthcare and more.

Emilie recently helped pass an historic bill in Vermont requiring fossil
fuel companies to pay for their own catastrophes. She believes we can meet
the global challenge of reducing greenhouse gas emissions to zero with
policy that focuses on equity and improves health, creates jobs, and saves
people money.

Other priorities include universal healthcare, expanded public transit,
and a house-first approach to ending homelessness. For the past decade,
Emilie has worked with affordable housing groups and unions, and is
co-chair of the Labor Caucus.

★ ★ ★

Our Revolution is proudly supporting the top labor candidate for Portland
City Council — Jonathan Tasini, a 32-year member of United Auto Workers.

The entire council is being restructured and will have 12 new councilors -
so this is a chance to think big and pass policy that can serve as an
urban pro-labor model for the entire nation!

With the most union endorsements of any of the 70+ candidates across the
four Portland districts, Jonathan is championing a pro-labor majority to
defend workers’ rights.

★ ★ ★

Congrats to Janeese Lewis George who won her primary and is likely to win
re-election in November to the DC City Council (Ward 4).

Our Revolution was proud to endorse Janeese because we know she is the
progressive leader we need. Janeese is on a mission for community
empowerment and social justice to shape a brighter, fairer future for all.

Growing up in a working-class family Janeese learned early on the
importance of family, hard work, education, and public service. Inspired
to fight inequities head on, she is an experienced attorney, civil
servant, and community activist.

Since being elected to the DC Council in 2020, Janeese has served on
committees for transportation and environment, labor and workforce, human
services, and more.

★ ★ ★

Congratulations to Annette Ramirez on winning the primary runoff for Tax
Assessor Collector in Harris County, Texas!

This important office is charged with improving election integrity in the
nation’s 3rd most populous county. We need to keep a progressive in charge
of voter registration rolls — not risk a Republican effort to “clean the
voter rolls” and make it harder to vote.

Annette will prioritize collections against corporations and big
businesses over homeowners and work for language justice and same day
voter registration.

★ ★ ★

[ https://act.ourrevolution.com/go/16898?t=1022&akid=6138%2E5885482%2Eg0wxVe ]Donate any amount to our 2024 Progressive Power Fund to make sure we
can mobilize our grassroots activists to get out the vote in each of these
key races!

★ ★ ★

★ ★ ★

More than 100 progressives joined the Massachusetts Unconvention on Zoom
call this week to plan out how best to shift the policy priorities of the
Democratic Party and oust incumbents stymying progress for the status quo.

“If we want to begin to have what I would call transformational politics
around housing, health care, jobs — it’s going to require taking on the
Democrats that are ensuring the continuation of the status quo,” Rand
Wilson, Our Rev Massachusetts leader and longtime labor organizer, told
[ https://act.ourrevolution.com/go/18004?t=1023&akid=6138%2E5885482%2Eg0wxVe ]Politico Playbook.

★ ★ ★

★ ★ ★

[ https://act.ourrevolution.com/go/17998?t=1024&akid=6138%2E5885482%2Eg0wxVe ][IMG]

Don’t miss Our Revolution’s Fight for the Future Town Hall, LIVE this
Monday with U.S. Rep. Jamaal Bowman, Vermont Lt. Gov. David Zuckerman,
Vermont Rep. Emilie Krasnow, and Rev. Lennox Yearwood Jr. of the Hip Hop
Caucus!

Join us as we organize to re-elect these inspiring climate champions and
talk with Rev. Yearwood about the next phase of the fight against fossil
fuels. RSVP now and we’ll send you a Zoom link to join the conversation at
8:30 pm ET / 5:30 PT on Monday!

[ https://act.ourrevolution.com/go/17998?t=1025&akid=6138%2E5885482%2Eg0wxVe ]RSVP HERE

★ ★ ★

[ https://act.ourrevolution.com/go/18005?t=1026&akid=6138%2E5885482%2Eg0wxVe ][IMG]

Progressive Congressman Jamaal Bowman is under attack by AIPAC and MAGA in
his run for re-election in NY-16 — but people power can win this race.

We hope you’ll sign up to hit the streets or hit the phones as part of our
GOTV operation, led by Our Revolution Volunteer Organizer Joe Lawrence.

In this moment, we must carry the message for Peace any way we can. Every

We're gonna make sure they know they should feel lucky to have our work!” Wendell Potter, author and whistleblower, spoke on the HealthCare Crisis, and a host of other speakers dug into key progressive priorities ranging from the Housing Crisis to Social Security. ★ ★ ★ Mark your calendar for June 11th, and join us LIVE to discuss Worker Organizing with the Economic Policy Institute and new developments at the National Labor Relations Board. NLRB General Counsel Jennifer Abruzzo will give us a breakdown on all the major reforms her office has undertaken. And, Our Revolution Chair Larry Cohen - former President of the Communications Workers of America - will join her on a panel to discuss their impact on workplace organizing. We’ll learn about the measures the NLRB has taken to support worker organizing and bargaining rights under the Biden administration, and hear from Cindy Estrada, Strategic Advisor to the President for the Center for Transformational Organizing, AFL-CIO. [ ]RSVP here to join at 2pm EST/11am PST on June 11th and lift up the fight for worker power! ★ ★ ★ ★ ★ ★ Right wing billionaires, corporate cronies, AIPAC, and MAGA donors are pouring millions into Democratic primaries trying to unseat some of our top progressive champions in Congress. Our Revolution and the grassroots progressive movement are rallying to out-organize the Big Money. This means speaking directly to voters by phone banks, online outreach, and knocking doors. In the upcoming primary contests, we refuse to let powerful voices like Rashida Tlaib, Ilhan Omar, Cori Bush, Jamaal Bowman and others be silenced by the donor class. We will fight for democracy! [ ]DONATE TO HELP US DEFEND AND EXPAND PROGRESSIVE POWER IN CONGRESS IN 2024 ★ ★ ★ Our Revolution is once again endorsing Alexandria Ocasio-Cortez for re-election to Congress in NY-14! AOC continues to be a powerful voice for our progressive priorities from ending student debt to Medicare for All to the Green New Deal. She has been an outspoken advocate for a Ceasefire and Peace in Gaza. With right wing and corporate money pouring into the race, it’s critical that our grassroots movement do everything we can to keep her in office! ★ ★ ★ Our Revolution is happy to stand with David Zuckerman in his run for re-election as Lt. Governor of Vermont! David has been a lifelong ally of Bernie Sanders as well as an organic farmer, environmentalist, and champion for the working class. We look forward to hearing from him on our [ ]LIVE Call Monday about his work to advance climate action and hold Big Oil to account in the Green Mountain State, where fossil fuel companies can no longer pollute with impunity! Read more about the new legislation to do just that in [ ]Rolling Stone. ★ ★ ★ Our Revolution is excited to endorse State Rep. Emilie Krasnow for re-election in Vermont, where she has been a powerful champion for climate, housing, healthcare and more. Emilie recently helped pass an historic bill in Vermont requiring fossil fuel companies to pay for their own catastrophes. She believes we can meet the global challenge of reducing greenhouse gas emissions to zero with policy that focuses on equity and improves health, creates jobs, and saves people money. Other priorities include universal healthcare, expanded public transit, and a house-first approach to ending homelessness. For the past decade, Emilie has worked with affordable housing groups and unions, and is co-chair of the Labor Caucus. ★ ★ ★ Our Revolution is proudly supporting the top labor candidate for Portland City Council — Jonathan Tasini, a 32-year member of United Auto Workers. The entire council is being restructured and will have 12 new councilors - so this is a chance to think big and pass policy that can serve as an urban pro-labor model for the entire nation! With the most union endorsements of any of the 70+ candidates across the four Portland districts, Jonathan is championing a pro-labor majority to defend workers’ rights. ★ ★ ★ Congrats to Janeese Lewis George who won her primary and is likely to win re-election in November to the DC City Council (Ward 4). Our Revolution was proud to endorse Janeese because we know she is the progressive leader we need. Janeese is on a mission for community empowerment and social justice to shape a brighter, fairer future for all. Growing up in a working-class family Janeese learned early on the importance of family, hard work, education, and public service. Inspired to fight inequities head on, she is an experienced attorney, civil servant, and community activist. Since being elected to the DC Council in 2020, Janeese has served on committees for transportation and environment, labor and workforce, human services, and more. ★ ★ ★ Congratulations to Annette Ramirez on winning the primary runoff for Tax Assessor Collector in Harris County, Texas! This important office is charged with improving election integrity in the nation’s 3rd most populous county. We need to keep a progressive in charge of voter registration rolls — not risk a Republican effort to “clean the voter rolls” and make it harder to vote. Annette will prioritize collections against corporations and big businesses over homeowners and work for language justice and same day voter registration. ★ ★ ★ [ ]Donate any amount to our 2024 Progressive Power Fund to make sure we can mobilize our grassroots activists to get out the vote in each of these key races! ★ ★ ★ ★ ★ ★ More than 100 progressives joined the Massachusetts Unconvention on Zoom call this week to plan out how best to shift the policy priorities of the Democratic Party and oust incumbents stymying progress for the status quo. “If we want to begin to have what I would call transformational politics around housing, health care, jobs — it’s going to require taking on the Democrats that are ensuring the continuation of the status quo,” Rand Wilson, Our Rev Massachusetts leader and longtime labor organizer, told [ ]Politico Playbook. ★ ★ ★ ★ ★ ★ [ ][IMG] Don’t miss Our Revolution’s Fight for the Future Town Hall, LIVE this Monday with U.S. Rep. Fellow American,

Primary Day is days away and \*\*unless I can raise an additional $9,428 before midnight, I’m not sure I’ll have the resources to win.\*\* I’ve spent the entire afternoon reviewing the numbers with my finance team, and here’s the short of it:

1. A few years ago, this seat was Blue, \*\*and we barely flipped\*\* – meaning our race is a top target for Pelosi because she knows it’s a purple district.

2. We have a strong team on the ground, _and a big chunk of our fundraising budget goes towards buying pizza for volunteers, providing yard signs to folks, and keeping this campaign running._

3. When we miss our weekly goals, even by a couple of hundred bucks, \*\*we have to pull back on all our campaigning efforts\*\* – and we really can’t afford to backpedal with the election just _ \*\*a few\*\* _ days away.

I need 49 donors to step forward to help reach our goal this week, can I count on you?

My team and I have a follow-up meeting to discuss the budget next Friday at 12pm, so please help out before then.

Thanks for all you’re doing.

Gratefully,

( https://email.cloud2.secureclick.net/c/38066?id=10259496.4363.1.fff5f0ebf114bf466306c08be81b84e2 )

Nancy Mace
