**The Court Has Denied Part of Soros & Friends Challenge to Our Repeal of Ranked Choice Voting. ****“Initiative petitions require far more time and effort than an individual candidate going to the Division's office to sign the paperwork to file for election. As a practical matter, a successful initiative petition requires getting hundreds of circulators to gather thousands of signatures from across the largest State in the Union. The Court believes that by accepting the 22AKHE petition as facially valid before the mandatory deadlines, the Division could then also accept corrections ot individual certification affidavits, up and until hte 60-day deadline for reviewing signatures. Given the parties' stipulation that no new signatures were gathered after the cited deadlines, any other interpretation of the statutory deadlines would run afoul of the Alaska Supreme Court, because voters who timely sign a petition "have a right to participate in the initiative process and should not be disenfranchised because of the error of a circulator that had no impact upon them."****“As a matter of law, the Division acted within its authority in allowing the Sponsors to make corrections to the certification affidavits on individual petition booklets after they were filed, but before the Division completed counting signatures. Hey team,
It’s no secret that a bunch of old bigots are leading the charge for intolerance, but recently they’ve really been outdoing themselves.
Transphobes at the Texas GOP convention called for “spiritual warfare” against trans rights. No joke, they’re calling gender-affirming care “child abuse” and are convinced that our fight for tolerance is a ploy to take over the country.
**Yeah. It’s wild.**
But do you know what these so-called prayer warriors actually need to be concerned about?
The fact that:
* **54% of trans and non-binary teens have considered suicide.**
* **29% have _attempted_ suicide.**
* **63% of anti-trans bills are even being _considered_.**

It’s people like this who make it _infinitely_ harder for our trans and non-binary friends to get the support and care that they need. They create a toxic culture and environment where they DO NOT feel comfortable speaking out in their cities, schools, or even their homes.
[If we want to make the world safer for our trans and nonbinary friends, we have to DEMAND our state legislators support gender-affirming care. Pramila has been fighting for racial justice her whole life. As a woman of color and an immigrant, she knows what it means to have the deck stacked against you. Through working to reform the policing system in Seattle, championing the fight to restore voting rights, and fighting to raise the federal minimum wage — Pramila is combatting the pillars of injustice that have disproportionately discriminated against Black and brown folks for far too long.
**[LGBTQ+ Rights ››](https://act.pramilaforcongress.com/go/47393?c0=pj-email-20240608-aa.4UUsKj&refcode=em20240608-3963-3&t=4&akid=3963%2E420207%2ERxJ8uv)**
**Pramila knows that despite recent triumphs, most states still lack clear non-discrimination protections for LGBTQ people. And with recent attacks from the far-right on our LGBTQ communities, Pramila is ready to use the full force of her membership on the Congressional Equality Caucus to fight for the Equality Act.**
**[Immigration ››](https://act.pramilaforcongress.com/go/47393?c0=pj-email-20240608-aa.4UUsKj&refcode=em20240608-3963-4&t=5&akid=3963%2E420207%2ERxJ8uv)**
As the first immigrant to hold the position of Ranking Member on the House Immigration Subcommittee, Pramila is determined to build immigration policies that reflect our values of family, human dignity, and work. She knows how important it is to fully embrace the contributions that immigrants make to our communities.
**[Energy and the Environment ››](https://act.pramilaforcongress.com/go/47393?c0=pj-email-20240608-aa.4UUsKj&refcode=em20240608-3963-5&t=6&akid=3963%2E420207%2ERxJ8uv)**
**Pramila is not afraid to stand up to polluters and climate change deniers, and grow our movement to combat climate change. As a proud co-sponsor of the Green New Deal, as well as a champion of the clean energy economy, Pramila knows that this work will only come to fruition through unwavering commitment and dedicated advocacy for our climate.**
**We need to ensure that our Congress keeps these issues, and many more, at the forefront of our priorities****, Peter. And your voice is exactly the push we need to ensure that we can stay on the right track.**
Thank you for your continued faith and support in this movement.
Team Jayapal

#
Derek, we don’t make a decision to endorse or support a candidate lightly.
We look at a ton of factors, but we also get to know them personally. Ultimately, we ask whether they’ve got the heart to serve.
A lot goes into those decisions because our support comes with a lot of resources. We spend a majority of the money we raise on our own candidates because our support can flip seats and win races.

But both of our candidates — Andy Kim for U.S. Senate and Herb Conaway for New Jersey’s 3rd Congressional District — won their primaries.
We’re so proud, and we thought we should let you know because your donations are what make this kind of thing happen. But there’s no time to rest, because Virginia’s primary is in just a few weeks and we have important candidates running in that state, too.
We’re spending continuously now, and we’ve already committed millions through Election Day. We’ve got to raise as we spend, or we’ll quickly run out of resources. And we’re hoping that you’ll be able to help us refill those coffers today.

body:
# [](https://act.katieporter.com/go/9?t=1&akid=38895%2E3422442%2EA4E-wu)
Derek, it’s Katie Porter.
A few years ago I attended a reception for newly elected Members in DC. A lobbyist came up to me and said “Well, I guess you’re one of the new Members we’ll never see.” I asked him why. He said it was because I didn’t take corporate PAC money.
**Since that day, I’ve said clearly—if lobbyists want to meet with me, they better bring their good ideas, not their checkbooks.**
As Members of the House, we are one vote of 435. That often means only a fraction of the bills we want to pass will ever become law. **But we all have a choice to make when it comes to corporate PAC money.** As Members of Congress, we’re privileged to be in positions of power, and we should use our power to stand up to the status quo and corporate special interests.
But unfortunately, this attitude isn’t the norm in Washington. Too many politicians are beholden to corporate PAC and lobbyist money and a system of legalized corruption. Our housing crisis, climate change, and rising prices are a direct result of this system, which puts corporate profits ahead of people.
**That’s why I started Truth to Power, an organization dedicated to supporting Democrats who reject corporate PAC money.** These candidates can only compete because of grassroots support, and so your donation helps us make all the difference. **[I hope you’ll consider joining me by giving a $5 contribution to Truth to Power today.](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/ttp-em-20240608?refcode=em20240608-38895&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&refcode2=38895_3422442_A4E-wu&akid=38895%2E3422442%2EA4E-wu)**

Thanks for considering,
Katie Porter

clean_body: Derek, it’s Katie Porter. A few years ago I attended a reception for newly elected Members in DC. A lobbyist came up to me and said “Well, I guess you’re one of the new Members we’ll never see.” I asked him why. He said it was because I didn’t take corporate PAC money. Since that day, I’ve said clearly—if lobbyists want to meet with me, they better bring their good ideas, not their checkbooks. As Members of the House, we are one vote of 435. That often means only a fraction of the bills we want to pass will ever become law. But we all have a choice to make when it comes to corporate PAC money. As Members of Congress, we’re privileged to be in positions of power, and we should use our power to stand up to the status quo and corporate special interests. But unfortunately, this attitude isn’t the norm in Washington. Too many politicians are beholden to corporate PAC and lobbyist money and a system of legalized corruption. Our housing crisis, climate change, and rising prices are a direct result of this system, which puts corporate profits ahead of people. That’s why I started Truth to Power, an organization dedicated to supporting Democrats who reject corporate PAC money. These candidates can only compete because of grassroots support, and so your donation helps us make all the difference. Thanks for considering, Katie Porter Katie Porter started Truth to Power to support Democrats who reject corporate PAC money and are running to protect the environment, restore the nationwide right to an abortion, and create an economy that works for working people. **TWO more days** , Fellow Conservative!

The first Montana U.S. Senate of the general election is this Sunday, and we’re working to make sure every voter in the state knows about it.

As a former Navy SEAL, I have a knack for reading people. The plan is to expose Jon Tester for who he really is—in front of the entire state of Montana, live on TV, challenging him on his nearly 20 years of flip-flops in the U.S. Senate and his record of voting along party lines over 91% of the time.

I’ll begin by highlighting his entrenched status as a Washington, D.C. insider. After nearly twenty years of flip-flopping and mindlessly lending his vote to every Democrat president he’s served under, it’s time for a new generation of leaders.

| Hey! This email is a quick 3-minute explainer about **3 THINGS YOU NEED TO KNOW** about the California 🌍 referendum this November that underscore our mission at the Jane Fonda Climate PAC: **ONE: Critical Health Protections Under Threat** In 2022, California passed a groundbreaking law prohibiting new oil and gas wells within 3,200 feet of homes, schools, hospitals, and other sensitive areas in our communities. This law safeguards over 7 million Californians from the harmful effects of toxic pollutants linked to respiratory and neurological diseases. Big Oil is now spending millions to overturn this law through a ballot referendum this November, jeopardizing the health and safety of our communities. **TWO: Big Oil’s Deceptive Campaign** Big Oil's relentless pursuit of profit has led them to launch a massive misinformation campaign. Their goal is to trick voters into believing that these essential protections are government overreach instead of modest, common-sense measures to protect public health. The stakes are high. A win for Big Oil empowers them to dismantle environmental protections nationwide. We’re up against an industry with virtually unlimited funds to spread its deceptive narrative. **THREE: Our Fight and the Path Forward** But there is hope. Jane PAC is a part of a powerful coalition of advocates and community leaders fighting this referendum. This email is a quick 3-minute explainer about 3 THINGS YOU NEED TO KNOW about the California 🌍 referendum this November that underscore our mission at the Jane Fonda Climate PAC: ONE: Critical Health Protections Under Threat In 2022, California passed a groundbreaking law prohibiting new oil and gas wells within 3,200 feet of homes, schools, hospitals, and other sensitive areas in our communities. This law safeguards over 7 million Californians from the harmful effects of toxic pollutants linked to respiratory and neurological diseases. Big Oil is now spending millions to overturn this law through a ballot referendum this November, jeopardizing the health and safety of our communities. TWO: Big Oil’s Deceptive Campaign Big Oil's relentless pursuit of profit has led them to launch a massive misinformation campaign. Their goal is to trick voters into believing that these essential protections are government overreach instead of modest, common-sense measures to protect public health. The stakes are high. A win for Big Oil empowers them to dismantle environmental protections nationwide. We’re up against an industry with virtually unlimited funds to spread its deceptive narrative. THREE: Our Fight and the Path Forward But there is hope. Jane PAC is a part of a powerful coalition of advocates and community leaders fighting this referendum. Together, we’re committed to educating Californians about the true dangers of nearby oil drilling and mobilizing them to reject Big Oil’s self-serving agenda. | | Dear Peter,
---
| | I understand not everyone had the foresight to support President Trump on day one. And that’s okay, heck I have a few friends who didn’t even vote for President Trump the first time, but enthusiastically supported him for re-election.

The fact of the matter is, within two years President Trump was already on track to be one of the greatest presidents of our lifetimes.

My opponents now claim to support President Trump now that they are running against me for congress, and maybe they do, but I have to question the authenticity when:
1. One opponent said “Trump Sucks” in 2016, then endorsed Joe Biden (IN 2020)

2. One said “Trump is an idiot in 2016” then compared supporters of Trump to Nazi collaborators in 2018.

3. My last major opponent said “the wall isn’t going to happen.” and didn’t lift a finger for him in 2020.

_**And then there’s me. **_

I am a Day One Trump supporter. I supported President Trump when he came down the escalator in 2015.

It wasn’t popular at the time, but when I saw Donald J. Trump, I knew he was the leader we needed in our country.

Friend, President Trump cannot afford to get back into the White House and have Republicans in Congress that don’t support him.

Please help however you can. Please feel free to call me at 702.908.7518. I’d love to have your vote as well!

Friends,
Today marks the first anniversary of the decision in _Allen v. Milligan_ , when the U.S. Supreme Court struck down Alabama’s discriminatory congressional map as a violation of the Voting Rights Act.
It was a resounding win for communities of color who have been historically disenfranchised by unfair redistricting practices. Our affiliate proudly supported some of the Alabama voters fighting to ensure that their voices would be heard and rights protected.
**But this victory was but one step on a long and relentless journey — one that continues to this very day.**
[**Anti-democracy forces will always keep trying to reverse progress, so it’s critical that this movement work tirelessly to challenge discriminatory voting maps, protect the rights of marginalized communities, and achieve a more inclusive democracy for all. Will you mark this occasion by rushing a donation to All On The Line today?**](https://click.everyaction.com/k/86534484/478185644/-1005769014?refcode=don_aotl_redite_email_junefun_email_20240608-AOTL-AllenvMilligan-Olivia_&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9FQS9FQTAxMy8xLzg5Mjk2IiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogIjRiZWJkZWVmLWMwMjUtZWYxMS04NmQyLTYwNDViZGQ5ZTA5NiIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=P9yR3kobUTreTKzW5FxQk7n2etDNl3nivkXovRegAI4=)

body:
I’m taking on career politician Jon Tester in a head-to-head debate this Sunday! | [](http://links.itsourgreatamerica.com/u/click?_t=442fb7cf105f4725a8bda0b6bcffc1bd&_m=941c00784cc94ca5b4aabef417fdd1be&_e=GVWR2tUDZYBAI0gPXgdOH3fy3HaI2v-RsxVRaXjvaKuTuqBdf2r8Y3eAoukU9PZILnSF2tgbyIxOmw7kqftrKk2-Wn-LwZY72STYqXb0pC-2tkKldwu2zePhAIqHCO-oQwMg5FjfMvm8tkF67Z4jmxWXObLjIN5tYilgk8QAYpqExQ097aJx3ehwgc4AQ5TXA5jqG56JSZSfXAM7kQ-BDBcoxhlRAKmuBy5wbv-VzQUN86E0zImMuSvljN5M4_ox6NZlzRPkqlEeeuXAAG90r4f_6vdygKr6Ev0aeAlC6CX7PPVMd-JGepUE9SEG2CIwDnEc00QUw6YSqOyMp78uVEiIHtI5XyDufgaJloNC1dBGh6hZwcQd6uqZDTWPBUxuyLQGfpRJ1oQhZlXJhTr2kw%3D%3D)

---
**TWO more days** , Peter!

The first Montana U.S. Senate of the general election is this Sunday, and we’re working to make sure every voter in the state knows about it.

As a former Navy SEAL, I have a knack for reading people. The plan is to expose Jon Tester for who he really is—in front of the entire state of Montana, live on TV, challenging him on his nearly 20 years of flip-flops in the U.S. Senate and his record of voting along party lines over 91% of the time.

I’ll begin by highlighting his entrenched status as a Washington, D.C. insider. After nearly twenty years of flip-flopping and mindlessly lending his vote to every Democrat president he’s served under, it’s time for a new generation of leaders.

Voters need to understand what a disaster this man is - and how much harm he’s done to the country with his continued presence in the Senate. name: DC Daily Journal
subject: Dangers of eating spinach
body:
Untitled Document

Please read the
following message from our sponsor.

Spinach is often promoted as a
healthy green, but contains FAR more downsides than good sides...

Spinach is one of the highest
oxalate foods that's commonly eaten by modern humans (in addition
to beet greens, beets, almonds, and other veggies and nuts).

The amount of oxalates in a
serving of spinach is extremely high, up to 600 mg in a normal
sized bowl. The "safe" amount of oxalates in a daily diet
according to world renowned oxalate expert Sally Norton should be
between 100-200 mg per day total to avoid a lot of the health
problems caused by high oxalate plants.

So you can see how concerning
spinach is with these extremely high oxalate levels.

The problem with eating too much
oxalates too frequently is that it can cause serious issues such
as kidney stones, thyroid problems, gut damage, skin issues, and
joint pain.

In fact, some people have even
gotten "oxalate poisoning" by drinking green smoothies too often
and had to go to the ER for kidney failure.

In addition, the nutrients in
spinach such as calcium and iron are very poorly absorbed by the
human body, with a dismal 3-4% bioavailability. Compare that to
the very high bioavailability (high absorption) of nutrients like
iron and calcium in meat and dairy at 30-40% bioavailability.

Overall, I believe that spinach
has more cons than pros, and I avoid it. Dozens of my clients
and friends have also reported dramatically improved digestion
and less joint pain when eliminating leafy greens such as
spinach.

More problems with a particular
common vegetable below that could be damaging your gut and
hormones...

Broccoli vs Kale vs Green
Beans... (the #1 WORST veggie for your gut & energy)
According to the best-selling
author and world-renowned heart surgeon, Dr. Steven Gundry,
there's one veggie people over 40 should never eat.

This veggie can damage your gut
and disrupt your hormones... It contains a toxin that damages the
lining of your intestines, causes bloating, embarrassing gas, and
a bulging belly.

Do you know the veggie I'm
talking about? Make sure you do by clicking the one below you
think it is, and get the answer from Dr. Gundry himself on the
next page:

The right-wing media mogul turned “educator” decried universities as “evil” in his new blog

[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/86537243/478195687/2130526953?refcode=emwrapper&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNTkvMS8xMDc4NzgiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiNGQyNDYzNzgtYzkyNS1lZjExLTg2ZDItNjA0NWJkZDllMDk2IiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=m18C0H7k6iOz3DO2yick-RLws22KvBZpxL9wgeW03L0=&emci=4cfeac68-c925-ef11-86d2-6045bdd9e096&emdi=4d246378-c925-ef11-86d2-6045bdd9e096&ceid=14016711)
Peter,
Earlier this year, our Arizona newsroom, _The Copper Courier_ , was the first to break an important story about _PragerU_ ’s mission to put right-wing misinformation in Arizona’s public schools.
If you’re not familiar, _PragerU_ is a right-wing media company that produces an educational “curriculum” for kids containing videos like “What Radical Islam and the Woke Have in Common" and "Is There Really a Climate Emergency?"
**They even have a guest course taught by Tucker Carlson.**
[**In a moment, we’ll tell you more about Dennis Prager,_PragerU_ ’s founder, and his disturbing educational beliefs. But if you support our mission to expose right-wing misinformation and propaganda like _PragerU_ , can you chip in $20 now?**](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/86537244/478195688/-593472309?refcode=20240608-EM-PragerU&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNTkvMS8xMDc4NzgiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiNGQyNDYzNzgtYzkyNS1lZjExLTg2ZDItNjA0NWJkZDllMDk2IiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=m18C0H7k6iOz3DO2yick-RLws22KvBZpxL9wgeW03L0=)
So who is Dennis Prager? Prager is a conservative talk radio host of the _Dennis Prager Show_. Prager founded _PragerU_ in 2009 in part to carry out his life’s mission of influencing “as many people as possible to adopt Judeo-Christian and American values.”
It’s hard to overstate _PragerU_ ’s influence since its creation. _PragerU_ ’s videos garner more than a billion views per year.
**In addition to Arizona,_PragerU_ ’s content has been approved for use in the Florida, Oklahoma, New Hampshire, and Montana public schools. **
Central to Dennis Prager’s educational philosophy is a hatred of college and universities, or as he put it in a recent blog post:
[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/86537245/478195689/2081106790?refcode=20240608-EM-PragerU&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNTkvMS8xMDc4NzgiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiNGQyNDYzNzgtYzkyNS1lZjExLTg2ZDItNjA0NWJkZDllMDk2IiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=m18C0H7k6iOz3DO2yick-RLws22KvBZpxL9wgeW03L0=)
In the blog post, Prager also wrote about how young people “never” return from college “finer, kinder, more moral or intellectually more developed.” Instead, he claims college-educated people have been “brainwashed” into anger and contempt.
**Simply put, Dennis Prager is a dangerous, far-right propagandist. His radical curriculum and his worldview don’t belong in our public schools. **
And that’s what makes COURIER’s work so important. With your continued support, our newsrooms can continue to hold state officials who enact these policies. Parents in these states deserve to know what their kids might be learning in school, and we’re proud to provide that service in communities where bad information is likely to spread.

I’m taking on career politician Jon Tester in a head-to-head debate this Sunday! | [](http://links.bestamericanow.com/u/click?_t=f6e78b69acbb4291bd75bc93fae35a62&_m=4f88b350c64c4378a07c1fe5a7f70171&_e=3k5eAtHc9aRIKZqgq8aiMrkBoiUroJrmptgEtW7JDsdIF5TRfcvWaZ0bbSwmQxzq_ur5lyXvQ2MyVLPcSUnxUbMeupPQHUNVt-mSVQcGPw-MrKovIb4OFrZF_sxClHXyfU_asRK8qch62h941NY8Wj4v2fUJOVjB4KbRIGYr8qBYKBWkOblrdtahHQhLp0SyEvl4YmsQBhSkrpla8RrXQSH3_qApuVsRohj6lhLql-lY5a-ttNjx_bxTMBlZ5WT3-_SrdNAodaWVxDpZkBJGQAAOwOpjPZ0sLCU7yNgZe3ITLbXjz9l-Dsajp5nxLoQabtpQo__7tE9Ju6XZK-QQ2rSCP-Ybl5ZUfQKHY6FYDvB581fteWgdEihMA3DVT39AgwqpJqsCMM5FIcvY6xxvm7sLOSzIXgtmPCCtFTw-TBY%3D)

**TWO more days** , Peter!

The first Montana U.S. Senate of the general election is this Sunday, and we’re working to make sure every voter in the state knows about it.

As a former Navy SEAL, I have a knack for reading people. The plan is to expose Jon Tester for who he really is—in front of the entire state of Montana, live on TV, challenging him on his nearly 20 years of flip-flops in the U.S. Senate and his record of voting along party lines over 91% of the time.

I’ll begin by highlighting his entrenched status as a Washington, D.C. insider. After nearly twenty years of flip-flopping and mindlessly lending his vote to every Democrat president he’s served under, it’s time for a new generation of leaders.

Voters need to understand what a disaster this man is - and how much harm he’s done to the country with his continued presence in the Senate. body:
| Hi there, can I share something with you?

When I came out in college, I knew I was interested in a career in public service. But I feared that I would have to face a serious choice between pursuing the field of my dreams or living my authentic life openly. [](https://act.protectvoting.org/go/70006?t=6&akid=15013%2E878179%2EDWEAIb) After seeing others in the LGBTQ+ community demonstrate acts of courage by coming out, being themselves, and being public about who they are and who they love, I came to realize that I could do both:

**I could run for office and be honest about who I am — so that’s exactly what I did.**

When I became the first openly gay Senator elected in our nation’s history, I understood that I needed to use this extraordinary opportunity to make a difference in people's lives. From lowering prescription drug prices to protecting same-sex marriage through the _Respect for Marriage Act,_ I’ve worked hard every day since to do just that.

That's why I ran for office in the first place — not to make history, but to make a difference. And folks like you supported me because you wanted to make a difference, too.

[I’m facing my most competitive and expensive reelection yet, so I can’t keep up this work with your help. Will you help me continue to make a difference by splitting a donation between the Voter Protection Project and my reelection campaign today?](https://act.protectvoting.org/go/70006?t=7&akid=15013%2E878179%2EDWEAIb) If you've saved your payment information with ActBlue Express, your split donation between Tammy Baldwin and VPP will go through immediately: | [CONTRIBUTE $10 »](https://act.protectvoting.org/go/70007?t=8&akid=15013%2E878179%2EDWEAIb)

We have made incredible progress over the years in the fight for equality — but folks, we cannot mistake that progress for a total victory.

Republican-led state legislatures across the country continue to pass harmful legislation, especially targeting the transgender community and LGBTQ+ youth. **In 2024 alone, 515 anti-LGBTQ+ bills have been introduced across the country.**

It’s going to take all of us to counter these right wing attacks so everyone grows up knowing they belong, and that kindness and inclusion — not hatred and division — are American values.

[This Pride Month, I’m hoping you’ll support this important work by splitting a donation between VPP and my reelection campaign to send me back to the United States Senate.](https://act.protectvoting.org/go/70006?t=13&akid=15013%2E878179%2EDWEAIb)

Happy Pride, friend! 🏳️🌈

body:
Please allow me to share a story about the American Rangers who triumphed over Hitler at Pointe du Hoc. | | |
---
Peter -- On June 6, 1944, 225 American Rangers arrived by ship to Pointe du Hoc, a cliff on the coast of Normandy, France. They jumped into the waves and stormed the beach. They had only 30 minutes to eliminate the Nazi guns high above them that could halt the Allied invasion. They reached the top. They breached Hitler's Atlantic Wall. They turned the tide of war. _And they saved the world._ When we talk about democracy, what we don't talk about enough is how hard it is. The most natural instinct is to walk away -- to be selfish, to force our will upon others, to seize power, never give it up. Democracy asks the hardest of things -- to believe that we're a part of something bigger than ourselves. **Democracy begins with each of us, Peter. And it only survives if we're willing to stand up to save it.** That's what the Rangers of Pointe du Hoc decided 80 years ago on D-Day. And that's what, today, we have to ask ourselves yet again: _Will we stand against tyranny, against evil, against hate? Will we protect freedom in our time? Will we defend democracy?_ [**Peter, will you stand with me in this campaign to defeat Donald Trump? Your support in the amount of $25 -- or whatever you can spare -- is how we will win in November and preserve the progress we've made. Shane Desguin and Patricia Carpenter filed formal complaints regarding Florida Governor Ron DeSantis' attempts to withhold travel records from public disclosure.
As state employees, they were caught in the middle of a fight between Sunshine laws and DeSantis' humiliating failed campaign for Governor.
As public servants, they had to provide public records to the media as required under Florida law. But DeSantis sought to keep those records - and all the details within - secret from the public.
So the two employees did what most people would do in any other (normal) state: Filed a complaint.
Then the Florida Department of Law Enforcement (FDLE) investigation began.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/fd830962-8cfc-4649-a56b-2f118f5c0cb0?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
In almost an exact reproduction of what happened to me after I told my superiors I intended to file a complaint regarding orders to post misleading data to the COVID-19 dashboard, the[ DeSantis smear machine has sought out to destroy two people ](https://substack.com/redirect/2569dc35-8074-4a5e-8e9c-53f4d0204018?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)who stood up to him and for doing what was not only right, but required by law.
In a 126-page report, FDLE detailed its invasive and retaliatory actions, attempted to defame the employees, accused them of "insubordination," implied illicit sexual affairs, and even asked Tallahassee prosecutors to file criminal charges against them.
They even went after the children of one of the whistleblowers.
Their attorneys have rightfully pointed out DeSantis' pattern of "dealing with" whistleblowers:
Fire, attack, defame, threaten, arrest, charge, silence.
This time, state attorney Jack Campbell refused to play ball (expect his tenure to end - as it should for the many times he agreed to file (and later dismiss) charges against DeSantis' enemies).
Gary Fineout of Politico - one of DeSantis' biggest cheerleaders and [paid propagandist](https://substack.com/redirect/8862b268-cd8d-4593-b11d-eefb7c1c2226?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)s - got his hands on this 126-page report before anyone else.
Why he repeated the allegations made without any fact-checking or reference to the many laws broken by the creation of the report to begin with probably speaks to how he got the report - to make those claims public so they could be published.
It's not only shameful, it's illegal to retaliate against a whistleblower.
That the FDLE sought bogus criminal charges against these two former employees is yet another reason for the Department of Justice to intervene in Florida and stop the persecution of whistleblowers engaging in protected activity - even (especially) if that requires locking up all of those involved.
Someone, _anyone_ needs to step in and protect those who speak truth to power.

subject: This is a bare knuckle fight.
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Alexandria Ocasio-Cortez for Congress
body:
#
This is serious.
Courage to Change — Alexandria’s leadership PAC — is working hard to keep progressive champion Jamaal Bowman in Congress. CTC just spent $235,000 on TV and digital ads to support Jamaal ahead of his primary election on June 25.
Jamaal has been an unequivocal voice in supporting Palestinian human rights and calling for a ceasefire. And because of that, he now has a serious primary challenge that is largely financed by AIPAC. They’re raising significant resources from Republicans, and have endorsed Republicans who supported the January 6th attacks.
**This is a bare knuckle fight.** For so long the fear of standing up for Palestinian human rights and _actually_ fighting for a lasting peace has been the third rail in American politics.
But **Courage to Change is fighting back against AIPAC’s massive spending** because it’s critical we keep growing our progressive movement in Congress this year.
[Will you split a contribution between Alexandria and Courage to Change today? Every single dollar will help us support progressive campaigns, their ability to organize, and their shot at victory.](https://act.ocasiocortez.com/go/14659?c0=aoc-email-20240608.Y8rN5b&refcode=em20240608-6585-P_FND_SPL_CTC&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1&akid=6585%2E2526796%2ENgOUWy)

Pa’lante,

Friend, **[This was God's message for me. ](http://links.gopmembership.com/u/click?_t=e3c9a4cac7f248a39c2a3d920479a441&_m=0e51d9c91191492abd78bb3f55e7d228&_e=Pv9v1SKJTLqHAiF14khy16wSA-8pABze58Gt01ifEFPiz_osa0N5CZAoWiPmMxMXllIxkroidBZic3Nfuqyz6Ifls0x6S83BLd6kCgpHX0JSpHMs48Iwxmbk1oz1Ngbal_E3Va7iU0WlQckY3jH19sNRURaNrS4QIw_6dR3tGxPx-i2upTnrRDFTg45BnMiS7A0TBQhQeancCzqD3d8z3gt0lw_VPwDyFqVHINMY0N6hrRPosJwATtN49O1-DdayYS9jFQz2dDfFak4K-ADQWSWkXLP7LCEM52-tLjgc1h_izMJeaJYLhzN0KtE1YtYk6jCWJj9gL2r0grn4I0_avZvXJVQdhHIVMnwJB-etp8WbiyzewsANrcTRGu67ssTO-O_Y9SP44zRc9dY3fUSfw5gXqIN30c6adVweiabGMnUnEdtZ7HsVokwEmyt1QhNv)** I didn't know if I was going to survive -- but I knew if I did, my life would belong to Him forever. In 2008, a roadside bomb in Afghanistan left me with burns over half my body. This was my vehicle after the explosion.
---
[](http://links.gopmembership.com/u/click?_t=e3c9a4cac7f248a39c2a3d920479a441&_m=0e51d9c91191492abd78bb3f55e7d228&_e=Pv9v1SKJTLqHAiF14khy16wSA-8pABze58Gt01ifEFPiz_osa0N5CZAoWiPmMxMXllIxkroidBZic3Nfuqyz6Ifls0x6S83BLd6kCgpHX0JSpHMs48Iwxmbk1oz1Ngbal_E3Va7iU0WlQckY3jH19sNRURaNrS4QIw_6dR3tGxPx-i2upTnrRDFTg45BnMiS7A0TBQhQeancCzqD3d8z3gt0lw_VPwDyFqVHINMY0N6hrRPosJwATtN49O1-DdayYS9jFQz2dDfFak4K-ADQWf8TjWc8QjNjNVntj5TMy1h_0W96_hLhN-dtVGsYF38SDR6adSUabwlnE4MKp36hWk51LANKaIxG9ysJcfP3ken60pxvXmwWly_NyRwzId_u_yqNvh0mbH_mphpe8uR0N-HxH7ZQRh7Icnhlph24r2L5wlx5n30700aD1DmiSMQk)

---
It's been an eventful two weeks... We watched with horror as President Trump was found guilty in a political witch hunt through a weaponized system of justice. While Biden and his allies spend their political capital to "get Trump," they have ignored the lawlessness their open borders policies have unleashed along our southern border and in cities across America. We need tough, proven, conservative leadership, and that's exactly what I'll bring with me to Washington. I will work tirelessly to end Joe Biden's war on Alaskan energy, hold his weaponized justice system in check, and secure our wide open border by completing Trump's wall and returning to common-sense conservative policies that work. Our country is a mess right now, but help is on the way.
---
[](https://nancyforalaska.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=1b2d5cc6ac5f5c7539b4b1d46&id=dff0dda8ff&e=a20d8ad2ed)

**Nancy Dahlstrom** _Candidate for Congress, Alaska At-Large_

** **✅ Speaker of the House Mike Johnson** **✅ House Republican Conference Chair Elise Stefanik** **✅ House Majority Leader Steve Scalise** **✅ House Majority Whip Tom Emmer** **✅ Winning for Women PAC** **✅ WY Congresswoman Harriet Hageman** **✅ E-PAC** **✅ Value In Electing Women (VIEW) PAC**

---
**My Interview with KTVF-TV**
---
I sat down with KTVF-TV during my most recent visit to Fairbanks to discuss my campaign for Congress, my priorities, and my thoughts on the state of Alaska and our country. _"I am very very concerned about what’s happening in our country. My husband and I have four kids. We have 11 grandkids, and what’s happening in our country is really just, it’s sickening . . . I watched what happened in the last congressional race and I thought, ‘I don’t want that to happen again.’ We need to have a strong Republican in Congress to represent the state of Alaska, and I believe I’m that person.”_ You can listen and watch the full interview [here](https://nancyforalaska.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=1b2d5cc6ac5f5c7539b4b1d46&id=8fca8934ba&e=a20d8ad2ed) with KTVF-TV.

---
[**📺 Watch Now**](https://nancyforalaska.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=1b2d5cc6ac5f5c7539b4b1d46&id=a03d5ea01a&e=a20d8ad2ed)
---
|
---
**My Statement on President Trump's Verdict**
---
Last week was an embarrassment to our judicial system and will have cascading effects on our legal system for years to come. The Democrats have weaponized our justice system and think they can use it to target their political opponents. Americans have watched this scam trial for weeks and saw it for exactly what it is: a joke. One person completely silent? Mary Peltola. Alaska deserves a representative who calls it like it is and speaks out against blatant attacks on justice. Alaskans stand with President Trump, and we will show our support at the ballot box this November.
---
|
---
**My Interview with Alaska Energy Hour** Last week, I joined Power the Future’s Rick Whitbeck on the [Alaska Energy Hour](https://nancyforalaska.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=1b2d5cc6ac5f5c7539b4b1d46&id=6edc674ef7&e=a20d8ad2ed) to talk about my recent trip to the southern border, Alaska’s energy potential, and more.
---
[](https://nancyforalaska.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=1b2d5cc6ac5f5c7539b4b1d46&id=cebc303b12&e=a20d8ad2ed)
---
**📻 Listen Now**
---
In the interview, I highlighted my experiences while taking a night tour of the southern border, including watching as migrants walked along the Mexico side of President Trump’s border wall toward an opening left by Joe Biden and Mary Peltola. You can listen to the full interview with Power the Future by [clicking here](https://nancyforalaska.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=1b2d5cc6ac5f5c7539b4b1d46&id=99459a75d9&e=a20d8ad2ed).
---
|
---
---
In case you missed it, I recently spoke with the [Fairbanks Daily News-Miner](https://nancyforalaska.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=1b2d5cc6ac5f5c7539b4b1d46&id=ccdc045a2d&e=a20d8ad2ed) about my run for Congress, the economy, and the need for natural resource development in Alaska. _“We should be leading the nation in oil and gas development. We have tons of gas and oil in the ground, and we just need to drill and get it out. Renewables are great, but I’m confident we cannot rely just on renewables. The perfect thing is a blend of the renewables with oil and gas. We can take all the power from turbines and solar and that can feed into the system to help people."_ You can read my full interview with the Fairbanks Daily News-Miner [here](https://nancyforalaska.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=1b2d5cc6ac5f5c7539b4b1d46&id=3ec0f5233d&e=a20d8ad2ed).

# [Remove Judge Cannon from the Trump case for continuing to delay the trial](https://default.salsalabs.org/T70eaccfc-5dfe-4220-a6b5-f652fd3d4d5a/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9)

| | | Trump-appointed Judge Aileen Cannon, who is overseeing the classified documents case, once again has shown her bias toward Trump as she bends over backwards to delay this trial. Cannon set a deadline in mid-June for Trump's team to respond to Jack Smith's request for a gag order, meaning she most likely won't rule on the matter until well into July, further delaying what is arguably the most important of all the Trump cases. Enough with the delays! We can't let this trial be controlled by someone in Trump's back pocket. Cannon needs to go, and the trial needs to proceed as soon as possible. body:

| | Dear Freedom Fighters,

In an effort to reduce emails coming to your inbox from me, I combined the last two weeks into one legislative update.

**Week 21**

Last Wednesday, I was at the Capitol for a Senate Education confirmation hearing for two executive nominations. One nominee was to serve on the School Facilities Oversight Board and the second nominee was for the State Board for Private Postsecondary Education. Many Senate confirmation hearings are wrapping up knowing the Legislature (hopefully) will Sine Die by the end of this month. The executive branch may have the duty to appoint agency heads, but the Senate gets to confirm its nominees.

Last Friday, the Arizona Free Enterprise Club, the Arizona Republican Party and Steve Gaynor, the 2018 Secretary of State Republican candidate, filed a lawsuit in federal court against the current Arizona Secretary of State for failing to comply with the National Voter Registration Act’s (NVRA) mandate that they maintain and update accurate voter registration records. The joint complaint alleges four Arizona counties have more registered voters than eligible citizens and there are over 500,000 ineligible voters listed on our state’s voter rolls.

States are required under NVRA to make a “reasonable effort” to remove the names of ineligible voters when they accept federal dollars for election administration. This means if someone dies or moves their voter registration should be cleaned from the rolls. If the Arizona Secretary of State doesn’t maintain clean voter rolls, this means we will not have fair and honest elections. The current SOS admitted in a [letter](https://bolickforarizona.us7.list-manage.com/track/click?u=3214fdbd528e32d06cf84fc86&id=be0fd4c144&e=a7ab36849c) dated April 22nd to the Arizona Legislature that he doesn’t have a plan to comply with the NVRA because it has been “in development” for quite some time now. It is a priority for us to restore trust and confidence in our state’s electoral system.

On Friday, I was also alerted that the local Greater Phoenix Chamber of Commerce would endorse my candidacy in the primary for supporting pro-growth, low regulatory policies benefiting our local businesses. I very much look forward to working with local businesses and its membership to continue supporting policies that cut red tape and barriers to entry so Arizona can continue to prosper.

Near close of business on Friday I stopped by Corey DeAngelis’ book tour stop for “The Parent Revolution” while he is in Phoenix to promote his new pro parental rights and educational freedom book. I hope to find time in the next few weeks to start reading it knowing I will not be consumed reading legislation the rest of session, only the state’s budget bills.

**Week 22**

On Tuesday, over lunch I had the opportunity to engage with a group of young conservative women who will be Arizona’s up and coming movers and shakers in the law and policy arena. It’s always fun to share my own personal insights about my unique trajectory into the political arena as well as some lessons learned.

On Wednesday, two bills I sponsored were debated on the House floor, including [Senate Bill 1435](https://bolickforarizona.us7.list-manage.com/track/click?u=3214fdbd528e32d06cf84fc86&id=ef0b3e53da&e=a7ab36849c). I introduced this legislation because I care about the safety of our children. During the interim in 2023, I met with a few individuals from around our state whose district school children received unwanted sexual advances by school employees. I believe all families with school-aged children attending our district and charter schools should have confidence in knowing there are adequate safety measures in place where their kids will be spending many hours learning each day.

After these incidents, each family shared with me that they were told the school conducted background checks prior to hiring these employees, but it turns out this wasn’t always the case, even though it is required. Sadly, these children were failed by the adults within their educational setting who were supposed to look out for their best interests and protect them.

Our public-school officials need to be held to a very high level of accountability, ensuring current and future employees who will be working with our children are properly vetted before they are hired and begin engaging with our children. Hopefully our public entities understand this responsibility now more than ever when it comes to keeping our children safe by properly conducting background checks during the hiring process, or, if an alleged violation of written policies arises, they thoroughly investigate the situation. Together, I look forward to keeping our children’s safety a top priority in their respective learning environments with the passage of Senate Bill 1435.

Also, on the House’s calendar was voting out [HCR 2060](https://bolickforarizona.us7.list-manage.com/track/click?u=3214fdbd528e32d06cf84fc86&id=d65d3011e2&e=a7ab36849c), the Secure the Border Act that will be on this November’s ballot. I discussed this ballot referral in my previous Week 20 Legislative Update. It is worth noting the Joint Legislative Budget Committee estimates the annual cost of illegal immigration to Arizona taxpayers is around $3.2 billion. The fiscal note to HCR 2060 estimates the cost of this measure may be about $325 million annually for border enforcement and incarceration costs. Biden’s open border crisis will continue to cost Arizona taxpayers a lot of money. Sadly, the safety of Arizona residents continues to rise since Biden is not vetting anyone coming across our open border and the flow of fentanyl continues to increase into our communities making them less safe.

Unfortunately, the House gallery was closed to the public due to the outbursts by paid leftwing activists that occurred in the Senate two weeks ago when we debated and passed HCR 2060. Those same paid activists filed a lawsuit alleging this ballot measure violates the single subject rule in the Arizona Constitution. Illegal immigration and lack of border security is the top issue impacting Arizona voters, so hopefully, this measure will be included on our general election ballot.

Wednesday was also a big “news” day for Hobbs getting smacked down on multiple fronts. One, the _Arizona State Senate v. Katie Hobbs_ , Maricopa County Superior Court Judge Scott Blaney determined Hobbs violated [A.R.S 38-211](https://bolickforarizona.us7.list-manage.com/track/click?u=3214fdbd528e32d06cf84fc86&id=ad49c2235e&e=a7ab36849c) by failing to appoint “Executive Deputy Directors” to circumvent the DINO committee violated state law. Judge Blaney concluded “improperly, appointed de facto directors for these 14 agencies, despite the actual job titles she has assigned to them.

In 2023, Hobbs submitted 22 nominations. Ultimately, six were confirmed by the State Senate. The lawsuit the State Senate filed alleged violations of state law because it was required the governor furnish nominations to the Senate to fill vacancies to be confirmed. Blaney’s order stated the statute “expressly requires the Governor to obtain the “advice and consent of the Senate.” In September 2023, Hobbs withdrew 13 director nominations still pending before the State Senate. Then, she reinstalled them with fake titles of “Executive Deputy Directors” causing President Warren Petersen to sue Hobbs over this illegal move.

Thus, Hobbs’ action was a direct violation of state law barring a nominee to serve longer than one year without the consent from the Senate, so Hobbs willfully circumvented the process, eliminating the legislative branch’s check on the governor’s power in the process as required by law. _To be continued...._

By the way, this is the same judge who ruled for the City of Phoenix to clean up the Zone (i.e.., homeless encampments downtown). Currently, the City of Phoenix is appealing that case and they also had that hearing on Wednesday.

Second, the local paper reported how Hobbs had received campaign contributions from an entity called Sunshine Residential Homes totaling approximately $400,000 to her personal campaign account and to an inaugural committee dark money fund she oversees benefiting the Arizona Democratic Party by awarding millions in taxpayer dollars over the past year to a dysfunctional group home via the Department of Child Services (DCS).

DCS approved a nearly 60% increase in the daily rate to Sunshine Residential Homes and they are the only provider to receive such an increase while other providers were denied pay increases and other providers’ contracts were terminated and removed from the state’s system altogether. I don’t support pay to play, and I don’t believe my fellow caucus members do either, so expect to see an investigation launched into this disgusting abuse of power by the Arizona Auditor General and others.

During the lunch hour on Wednesday, I stopped by a local business networking group with members representing the energy sector, retail, charities, etc. It is always good to meet new people and get reacquainted with individuals that may have come into my office while I served in the House.

On Thursday, I had the opportunity to tour a local data center based in Chandler. As Vice Chair of the Senate Committee on Finance and Commerce, I always enjoy interacting with local businesses to learn more about their business model and to see the best ways for government to get out of the way so they can thrive, create jobs, and grow their businesses.

I was alerted on Friday afternoon that the Senate Committee on [Finance and Commerce](https://bolickforarizona.us7.list-manage.com/track/click?u=3214fdbd528e32d06cf84fc86&id=5af07be25d&e=a7ab36849c) would be holding a hearing next week for three nominees to be appointed and confirmed to the Arizona State Lottery Commission.

Next week, the Senate will be at the Capitol to hold small group budget meetings which means Hobbs’ office and the legislature is getting closer to an agreement for next fiscal year’s state budget. Our state is in the middle of a budget shortfall, so expect to see a decline across the board compared to last year’s state budget to the one we will be voting for in the upcoming fiscal year. The State Senate is scheduled to meet on Wednesday, and maybe Thursday and Friday depending on how the budget negotiations are going between the two branches of government.

Finally, if you’d like to volunteer for our primary election campaign, please reply to this email and tell us how you’d like to help. We are building out the Bolick Brigade. The Republican primary will take place on July 30th, but we will be executing get-out-the-vote efforts leading up to the actual primary date. If you live in [District 2](https://bolickforarizona.us7.list-manage.com/track/click?u=3214fdbd528e32d06cf84fc86&id=4130934a3c&e=a7ab36849c) and you would like a yard sign, we can deliver one directly to you as well.

Thank you for your continued support! I look forward to working with you to save our state from a takeover by the far left. They have earmarked $2 million to buy this State Senate seat in November.

Take care,
Shawnna

body:
If Trump and Lake win, it’s going to be a living nightmare. It’s so dangerous that I don’t even want to consider it. Our democracy itself is at stake, and we have to do whatever we can to defend it.
#

Peter, this week was tough.
About as tough of a week as I can remember on this campaign.
For a while there it felt like everything that could possibly go wrong was happening — Republicans and outside groups were adding more money to their attack ads, our fundraising was way-way down, Kari Lake was ripping into me on social media, and Trump himself came to Arizona and attacked me. Personally.
But I’m not going to cut and run just because things get a little tough. And when it’s looking dark, I try to remember what’s at stake in this election.
I’m running for people like my mom, raising kids as a single mother and holding down multiple jobs just to get by.
I’m running for the Marine brothers I lost in Iraq.
I’m running for my son and daughter.
I’m running for everyone who grew up like I did, everyone who feels like they’re getting left behind by a system that doesn’t care about them.
If Trump and Lake win, it’s going to be a living nightmare. It’s so dangerous that I don’t even want to consider it. Our democracy itself is at stake, and we have to do whatever we can to defend it.
And right now, in this race, what stands between us and victory is whether or not we raise the resources we need to win.
[**So, I’m writing to ask whether you can chip in $5 or $10 tonight to my campaign. We’ve got an FEC deadline approaching at the end of this month, and it’s absolutely critical that we show strength out here. I need you, Peter. | | | [ ](https://www.jillstein2024.com/?e=e813143e1dc0d3b0ffcb007ffe357333&utm_source=jillsteinforpresident&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=ballot_access_resend_3&n=1)
---
Peter,****
---
Recently we sent out some fantastic news that you may not have seen, so we are sending it to you again just in case. We don't want you to miss this exciting update! We are on the ballot in 3 more states as of the end of May, bringing our total to 23 states where voters will have an alternative to the parties of war and Wall Street. **_Our people, peace, planet campaign is on the move!_** In Georgia, a new law was put in place that will allow Jill to be on the ballot by virtue of her becoming the Green Party nominee in August. In Washington state, volunteers have gathered over 1,200 signatures in just a few weeks and are adding to that number daily. In Delaware, we are nearing the threshold of 770 registered Greens to get us on the ballot. In Ohio, we have close to 8,000 signatures and should be turning in even more than that by the end of June. In Nevada, we have turned in 27,000 signatures, more than twice the required number. In Alaska, we will be submitting 6,000 signatures this week. I set a personal goal to raise $100,000, and I'm counting on you to help us get there by midnight: = The stakes couldn't be higher. Hey Derek, My name is Sam Cornale and I’m the Executive Director of the Democratic National Committee. We have to make a lot of difficult decisions in politics and I’m writing today to ask for your help to make sure one of those difficult decisions I made recently pays off. We had a meeting at DNC Headquarters where it was made clear that if we made a few additional unplanned investments, we could make some important inroads across a few key states. This additional investment isn’t something we budgeted for. I gave the green light anyway. And the reason I did was because I was betting that Democrats everywhere who understand the stakes of this election would step up to help fund some of these important investments. So if you've been waiting for the best time to make your first donation to the Democratic National Committee, there is no better time than today. | Fellow American,

There is a very concerning trend occurring in our country that has me worried for Americans who hold to biblical & faith-based values.

After the _Respect for Marriage Act_ was passed by a bi-partisan effort and signed into law, I am fearful that legal persecution will only intensify against Americans holding to faith-based values and who wish to conduct their lives according to their faith.
